Germany has only A KIE and needs HOL to survive. Will you move A HOL–RUH, allowing A KIE–HOL to reclaim my center? I’ll keep clear of French centers afterward. Russia’s advance threatens us both; please use your other units against its western flank.
Russia is at 11 and remains the solo threat. What are your Fall plans against its centers? Please keep your units clear of HOL; Germany needs to reclaim it to survive, and I’ll avoid Italian centers.

A KIE is my only unit and HOL is Germany’s last chance to survive. Will you keep your units clear of HOL this fall? I’ll avoid your other centers if you leave me that opening. Please state your intentions toward A KIE and the western front.

Russia’s A BUL can threaten TRI. I’m prepared to defend it; can A SER and A GRE pressure BUL this fall, while your other units contest Russia’s gains in RUM and SEV? Please tell me your plan so we don’t waste forces against each other.

Russia’s 11 centers still put everyone at risk. Can F NOR and F NTH contest F SWE or the Baltic this fall while F DEN stays protected? I’m holding the southern line against Russia; let me know where you can apply pressure.

I will defend Italy’s frontier and won’t help you take Austrian centers. Keep A BUL and your other southern forces clear of Italian centers this fall. Are you planning to attack TRI, or can we avoid spending units against each other?
This frontier is costing both of us. I can keep A BUD and A BUL out of VIE and GRE if you leave Russian RUM, SEV, and SMY untouched this fall. What are A RUM, A SER, and F SMY doing?
You will take HOL this fall. Please keep A HOL out of KIE and do not support A KIE; I need to recover KIE. I’ll keep A BER and A SIL clear of HOL and MUN. Can we avoid opening another front?

Austria is positioned to take Russian RUM, SEV, and SMY. Please move A VEN to TYR with F ADR supporting; I’ll keep my units clear of Italian centers and press Austria from the east. Are you willing to coordinate against Austria this fall?

A RUM will hold, with A SER supporting; A GRE will cover SER, and F SMY will hold to deny Russia a gain. I’m also guarding VIE from the eastern front. Please keep contesting Russian centers in the north, especially SWE.

I’ll keep my forces out of TRI and use A SER and A GRE to contain Russia’s A BUL without opening an Italian-Austrian front. A RUM and F SMY are focused on denying Russia gains. Please keep F TRI in TRI and A VEN clear of Austrian centers.

I can’t agree to leave RUM and SMY untouched while Austrian units occupy them and your armies occupy Austrian centers. A RUM and F SMY will hold; A SER and A GRE will defend my frontier. Withdraw from BUL and SEV if you want to discuss a quieter line.

A RUM will hold with A SER supporting; A GRE will cover SER, F SMY will hold, and A BOH will guard VIE. A MUN cannot take BER unsupported from its current position, so preserve your western units rather than risk an ineffective attack. Please keep your forces clear of Austrian centers.

I’m keeping F DEN in place, supported by F NOR and F NTH, to prevent Russia taking it. That leaves no safe attack on F SWE this fall. Please keep pressing Russia from the south, especially against its remaining Balkan or Black Sea centers.

F DEN will hold, supported by F NOR and F NTH; with Russia able to attack DEN from SWE, I can’t safely spare a fleet to contest F SWE. Please keep clear of English centers and press Russia from the east if possible—A HOL or A MUN toward BER would help.

A WAL and my other units will stay clear of EDI and your remaining centers. I’m pressuring Russia’s A BER from MUN and HOL; please contest SWE or another Russian position if you can, while protecting DEN and NOR.

I can’t move A HOL–RUH: Austria and I are pressuring A BER. I plan A HOL–BER, with A MUN supporting, which leaves HOL vacant for A KIE–HOL. Please make that move and reclaim HOL; I’ll keep clear of your centers afterward.
I’m not supporting A KIE or moving A HOL–KIE. I’m coordinating pressure on A BER from MUN and HOL; please keep your western forces clear of French centers and avoid escalating against MUN.

I’ll pressure A BER with A HOL–BER, supported by A MUN. HOL will be vacated, so Germany can use A KIE–HOL to reclaim its center. I’ll keep clear of Austrian centers; please continue focusing on denying Russia gains in the south.

I can’t leave A KIE in place: A KIE–HOL is my only chance to keep Germany alive. Please move A HOL–RUH so I can retake HOL, and support A MUN–BER from BUR if possible. I’ll keep A KIE out of BER and won’t attack your centers.

I’ll keep my units clear of HOL. I’m not positioned to strike Russian centers this fall, but I won’t help Russia take Austrian centers either. I’m using A VEN to move toward TYR while F TRI remains in TRI.

I won’t join an attack on Austria or help you take its centers. F ADR cannot support A VEN–TYR; F TRI can, but I’m not offering that support to your campaign. Keep your forces clear of Italian centers.

F TRI will remain in TRI, and A VEN will stay out of Austrian supply centers this fall. I can’t promise the frontier will be entirely quiet: I’m moving A VEN toward TYR, while keeping clear of GRE, SER, and your centers.

F BAL will attack DEN again, with F SWE supporting; A FIN will hold rather than target NOR. I can’t leave an English fleet in DEN, and I’m not agreeing to a quiet northern line while you contest my centers. I’ll keep F BAL clear of NTH.

I have no move planned against HOL this fall. KIE is a Russian center, though, and A BER will try to recover it; I can’t promise to leave A KIE undisturbed. Please don’t support France against my position in the east.

I’m not planning an attack on TRI this fall, and my southern forces are focused on the Austrian front. I’ll keep them clear of Italian centers. I can’t offer a wider promise beyond this turn, given the contest over Russian RUM, SEV, and SMY.

A CON will stay out of RUM and SMY this fall, but I will defend Russian centers and cannot accept Austrian occupation of RUM or SMY. Please withdraw A RUM and F SMY rather than widening the frontier; I’m not seeking a broader war with you.

notes.note: Fall 1908: hold KIE, Germany’s sole center; moving to HOL risks Russia’s BER taking KIE. France promises HOL–BER with MUN support, leaving HOL open, but preserving KIE is essential.

Defend DEN with NTH support against Russia’s threatened BAL–DEN attack while NOR moves to STP/NORTH to seize the Russian center if vacant. France promised to stay clear of English centers; Russia remains hostile.

Keep HOL to secure its Fall capture; Germany asked me to vacate, but that sacrifices a center. Support MUN-RUH and press the English coast from PIC/WAL. England and Austria urged pressure on Russia; Russia promised to avoid French centers.

Hold TRI with ADR support against a possible Russian attack; VEN→TYR as disclosed to Austria. Advance toward France via TUS→PIE and convoy POR→GAS; move fleets east and west for future pressure. Russia leads at 11; no new promises kept or broken this Fall.

Hold RUM and SMY to claim both centers; SER supports RUM against Russia. GRE pressures BUL, BOH covers VIE. Russia says CON stays out of RUM/SMY but rejects our occupation; watch for attacks. Italy promised TRI stays clear and VEN avoids Austrian centers.

Claim BUL and SEV; BER+BAL attack KIE. BUD attacks Austrian RUM with BLA support; CON pressures SMY. FIN attacks NOR with SWE support. France threatens BER; England defends DEN/NOR. Austria refuses to withdraw from RUM/SMY; Italy refuses to help.

messages.body: Please have F TRI support A SER holding and keep A TYR out of VIE this spring. I’ll keep A GRE and A RUM focused on the Russian frontier. Can we coordinate against Russia without opening an Austrian-Italian front?
Can you renew pressure on BER with A HOL–BER supported by A RUH, while A BUR supports A RUH holding? Russia’s A KIE may support BER, so please tell me what you can commit to this spring.
Are A BUL or A BUD targeting SER, and is A CON targeting RUM this spring? I will defend my centers. Keep those units clear of Austrian centers and we can discuss a quieter frontier.

Russia still has 11 centers and is threatening DEN. Please use your eastern units to press Russian centers this turn—especially BUD, SEV, or the Black Sea—and avoid opening a front against Austria. I’ll keep F DEN defended; what Russian-held center are you targeting?

Russia remains the immediate solo threat. What are A RUM, A SER, and F SMY targeting this turn? Please press BUD or another Russian center if feasible, and keep RUM and your other centers defended. I’ll continue holding DEN against Russia.

Please keep A YOR and F ENG clear of EDI and my remaining centers. Russia is still the solo threat; can A HOL or A RUH pressure KIE or BER this turn? I’m defending DEN and need your help containing Russia rather than an advance into English centers.
Russia remains the main solo threat. What are your plans for A RUM, SER, and GRE this spring—can you pressure BUD or BUL? I can press east from RUH if we coordinate against Russia’s western armies.
Your A GAS and F MAO are close to French territory. Can we keep the PAR–GAS and BRE–MAO fronts quiet this spring while we contain Russia? Please tell me your plans for GAS and MAO.

What are your plans for A BER, KIE, and NOR this spring? I’m trying to avoid opening a western front; please keep your forces clear of French territory while we work out whether pressure on your western flank can be contained.
A MUN is Germany’s last center. Will A BER and A KIE stay clear of MUN this spring? I’m not seeking Russian centers; I’d rather hold a quiet western boundary than give France an opening.

Russia now has A KIE and A BER adjacent to my last center. Please use A RUH to support A MUN holding this spring, rather than moving against MUN; I’ll keep A MUN clear of French centers. We should deny Russia another gain.

Could A TYR support A MUN holding this spring? Russia has A KIE and A BER nearby, and MUN is Germany’s last center. I’ll keep A MUN clear of Italian centers; denying Russia a western gain helps us both.
Can we coordinate a direct strike on Russia this spring? I can order F AEG–CON; A GRE could support that attack. What are A RUM and A SER doing, and can you support the move from GRE?
Please keep F DEN protected and consider F STP/NORTH–NOR with F NTH supporting, to contest a Russian center. Are you planning that or another move against Russia this spring?
I’m looking to focus east against Russia rather than open a western front. Will A BUR and A RUH stay clear of GAS and Italian centers this spring? What are your western units planning?
Are F DEN and F NTH attacking or supporting an attack on SWE this spring, and is F STP/NORTH targeting NOR? I can keep F BAL clear of NTH if you leave SWE and NOR alone; otherwise I’ll defend them.
A KIE can pressure MUN this spring. Will A BUR or A RUH attack or support A MUN? Please keep your units out of KIE; I’ll keep my forces clear of French centers if we avoid opening a western front.

Are A RUM, A SER, and F SMY targeting BUL, CON, or SEV this spring? I’m prepared to defend my centers, but would rather avoid widening the war. Keep your forces out of Russian centers and I’ll keep A BUL and A CON clear of GRE and VIE.

A RUM will hold, A SER will support its defense, and F SMY will hold. A GRE is committed to supporting Italy’s F AEG–CON, so I cannot attack BUD this turn. Please keep contesting Russian centers in the north.

A RUM and F SMY remain defensive, and I will protect my remaining centers. I expect A BUL and A CON to stay clear of GRE, VIE, and RUM; a quieter frontier requires your units to stop threatening Austrian centers.

Agreed: A GRE will support F AEG–CON. A RUM will hold, with A SER supporting its defense; please have F TRI support A SER holding as proposed. Keep A TYR out of VIE and A VEN clear of Austrian centers.

My southern units must defend RUM and support Italy’s strike on CON, so I cannot help pressure BER. Please proceed with A HOL–BER supported by A RUH if feasible, but account for Russia’s A KIE possibly supporting BER. Keep your units clear of Austrian centers.

F DEN will hold, with F NTH supporting its defense. F STP/NORTH is positioned to contest NOR; I won’t leave DEN exposed by sending NTH to attack SWE. I’m not agreeing to leave your northern centers alone while you remain at 11.

I’ll keep F DEN protected with F NTH supporting its defense, so I can’t use NTH to support F STP/NORTH–NOR this turn. STP/NORTH can still contest NOR. Please press a Russian center in the south, especially BUD, SEV, or the Black Sea.

A YOR and F ENG will stay clear of EDI and your other centers. I’m using A HOL–BER, supported by A RUH, while A BUR supports A MUN holding. Please keep contesting Russia’s northern position where you safely can.

A BUR will support A MUN holding, so Russia’s A KIE cannot take MUN with a simple attack. A RUH will support A HOL–BER, rather than support MUN; I’m trying to deny Russia BER while protecting your center. Please keep A MUN holding.

I’m committing A BUR to support A MUN holding, A RUH to support A HOL–BER, and A HOL to attack BER. My units will stay out of KIE. Please keep your forces clear of French territory and avoid attacking MUN.

A BUR and A RUH will stay clear of GAS and Italian centers; A HOL and my western units are focused east against Russia. I’ll keep the PAR–GAS and BRE–MAO fronts quiet this spring. Please keep your forces focused on the eastern front as well.

I’ll attack BER from HOL with RUH supporting. I plan BUR to support MUN holding rather than RUH holding, to help Germany withstand Russia’s likely pressure from KIE. Please continue denying Russia gains in the south and keep your forces clear of my centers.
I’m targeting CON: I’ll have F AEG support A BUL–CON if Austria makes that move. Please keep F DEN protected and continue contesting Russia from the north where you can.
Yes. A TYR will support A MUN holding this spring. I’ll keep it clear of German centers otherwise; denying Russia a gain at MUN is worthwhile.
Agreed: A GAS will stay out of PAR, and F MAO will stay clear of BRE. I’m keeping the western front quiet while coordinating pressure against Russia in the east.
Agreed: F TRI will support A SER holding, and A TYR will stay clear of VIE. Will A BUL attack CON? If so, F AEG can support A BUL–CON.
A BER and A KIE will stay clear of MUN this spring. I’d like to avoid opening another front; please keep A MUN clear of KIE and don’t support French pressure against BER.

A BER will guard the line, A KIE won’t move west into French territory, and A NOR will defend the north. Please keep A BUR and A RUH away from BER and KIE, and avoid supporting attacks there; I’ll keep my forces clear of French centers.

A BUD and A BUL are not targeting SER, and A CON will stay out of RUM this spring. I’m prepared to keep this frontier quiet if A RUM, A SER, and F SMY stay clear of Russian centers, including BUD, BUL, and CON.

notes.note: Hold MUN, Germany’s last center. Russia promised BER/KIE stay clear of MUN; France promised BUR support for my hold and RUH support for HOL–BER; Italy promised TYR support for my hold. Reassess after results.
Keep DEN defended with NTH support; contest Russian NOR with STP/NORTH. Russia remains the solo threat and has not agreed to a quiet northern line; France and Austria say they are pressing Russia.

BUR supports MUN holding as promised to Germany; HOL-KIE with RUH support pressures Russia. YOR takes open EDI, breaking my promise to England to stay clear of its centers. Italy promised quiet western front; ENG-IRI.

Press Russia: AEG–CON, with Austria’s GRE support agreed; ION to EAS. Keep TRI in place and TYR supports MUN as promised to Germany. GAS holds to keep France quiet; other fleets reposition, PIE stages via MAR.

Attack BUD with VIE, supported by RUM and SER; GRE pressures BUL. Keep SMY occupied rather than expose it supporting Italy. Russia promised to keep its southern units clear of Austrian centers; Italy promised TRI support for SER and TYR clear of VIE.

Attack RUM with GAL supported by BUD, BLA, SEV; CON supports BUL holding. BAL+KIE contest France's announced HOL-RUH attack on BER. SWE supports NOR against England's STP threat. Austria promised defense but rejects Russian gains; Italy warned me off Austrian/Italian centers.

messages.body: Russia is still the main threat. Can F STP/NORTH attack NOR with F NTH supporting, while you keep DEN secure? Please keep pressure on Russian centers this fall.
Please keep A KIE in KIE to secure that Russian center, and have A RUH support its defense against Russia. Can you also protect EDI so it transfers to you?
Let’s keep the frontier quiet: please keep F TRI in TRI and A TYR out of VIE. I can use A GRE to support F AEG–CON if you’re committing to that attack; what are your plans?

Russia is likely to gain RUM unless you contest it. Please order A SER–RUM with A BUD supporting; A BUD still holds the center while supporting. Italy can help pressure CON from the south. Keep denying Russia centers wherever feasible.

Your A EDI will take an English center unless it moves. Please vacate EDI to LVP this fall and keep clear of my remaining centers; I’ll keep my fleets clear of France. Please continue taking KIE from Russia.
Please keep pressure on Russia’s centers. If Austria orders F SMY–CON, can F AEG and F EAS support that move? A supported attack on CON would help offset Russia’s likely gain of RUM.

Russia’s A RUM can take your center this fall, while your A BUD can flip BUD back to you if it survives. Please have A SER support A BUD holding; can you also attack A RUM from SER, or is that too risky? I’m holding KIE and need us to deny Russia gains.

My A EDI is staying in EDI this fall, which will transfer the center to France if unopposed. Please don’t attack it with F NTH; focus instead on containing Russia in the north. What are F DEN and F STP/NORTH doing?

Russia’s A RUM is poised to take an Austrian center, so please use your eastern forces to pressure Russia rather than open a western front. Can you attack CON or BUL this fall? I’ll keep my units clear of Italian centers.

Can we coordinate against Russia this fall? I propose A MUN–BER with your A KIE supporting; please have A RUH support MUN holding and keep A BUR out of MUN. That gives you a shot at BER while preserving my last center.

Please have A TYR support A MUN holding this fall and keep it out of MUN. France and I may coordinate a supported move against Russian-held BER; keeping Germany alive also denies Russia an opening in the west.
What are your Fall plans for A BUD, A GRE, A SER, and F SMY? Russia is still the main danger, and I want to avoid a wasted Italian-Austrian clash. Please confirm which centers you intend to defend.

Can we keep the western front quiet this Fall? I’ll keep A GAS clear of PAR and A MAR clear of your centers if A BUR stays out of MAR and your eastern units don’t move against Italian positions. What are your plans?

Your southern units are close to Italy. Are A BUL, A CON, and A UKR staying clear of TRI and other Italian centers this Fall? Please confirm your intentions; I’m not looking to waste forces fighting you while the board remains unsettled.

A KIE is a Russian center, and A KIE can threaten BER. Will you withdraw A KIE to RUH or BUR and keep A BUR and A RUH clear of BER? I’ll keep my western forces out of French centers if you leave the Russian line alone.
Are you holding A BUD or moving it this fall? I intend to recover BUD and defend RUM. Keep F SMY and your armies clear of Russian centers, and I’ll keep my forces clear of VIE and GRE.
Is F STP/NORTH targeting NOR again this fall? A NOR will defend. If you leave NOR and SWE alone, I can keep F BER clear of DEN; otherwise I’ll contest your northern position.
A SER will support A BUD holding, so I won’t attack RUM from SER this turn. Please keep A KIE in KIE and have A EDI hold EDI so it transfers to you; I can’t reach EDI to protect it.
A GRE can support F AEG–CON. I’m keeping A BUD in place with A SER supporting its defense; please keep F TRI in TRI and A TYR clear of VIE so we avoid a frontier clash.

A BUD will stay in BUD, with A SER supporting it; I’m not attacking RUM from SER this turn. Keep A RUM and A GAL clear of BUD, and your forces out of VIE and GRE, if you want to keep this frontier quiet.

I can’t risk leaving BUD exposed: A SER will support A BUD holding rather than attack RUM. A GRE can support Italy’s attack on CON. Please send F STP/NORTH–NOR with F NTH supporting, and keep DEN secure.

F DEN will hold, with F NTH supporting its defense; F STP/NORTH will attack NOR. I will not attack A EDI this turn, but losing EDI is costly and I need you to keep clear of my remaining centers. Please continue pressing KIE.

F DEN will hold with F NTH supporting, so I can’t use NTH to support an attack on NOR without risking DEN. F STP/NORTH will attack NOR alone. Please follow through with A SER–RUM supported by A BUD; denying Russia RUM is vital.

F STP/NORTH will attack NOR again; F DEN will hold with F NTH supporting its defense. I won’t agree to leave NOR and SWE alone or trade away the pressure on your northern position. Keep F BER clear of DEN if you wish, but I’m still contesting your centers.
A KIE will stay in KIE, with A RUH supporting its defense. A EDI will also hold so EDI transfers to France. I’ll keep both units clear of Austrian centers; please keep pressing Russia in the south.
A BUR will stay clear of MAR and all Italian centers; A RUH will also stay clear. I’m keeping the western front quiet and concentrating on Russia. Please keep your forces focused east.
A KIE will remain in KIE; I won’t withdraw it to RUH or BUR. A RUH is supporting its defense. I’ll keep my units out of your other centers if you keep your forces clear of French territory.

I can’t support MUN holding with A RUH while also protecting KIE. Better: keep A MUN in MUN and support my A BUR–BER; A KIE will also support BUR–BER, while A RUH supports KIE holding. That gives us a strong attack on BER without leaving MUN exposed to a fleet attack.
A EDI will hold this fall so the center transfers to France. Please keep F NTH and your other fleets clear of EDI; I won’t move against DEN or STP. I’m continuing to pressure Russia from the east.

I’ll keep the western front quiet: A GAS and A MAR will stay clear of French centers. I’m committing F AEG–CON, with F EAS supporting, and have asked Austria to support from GRE. Please keep your forces clear of Italian positions.

I’m committing F AEG–CON, with F EAS supporting. Please have A GRE support that attack; F SMY could support it as well if you’re not using it elsewhere. F TRI stays in TRI, and A TYR will support A MUN holding as promised to Germany. What is F SMY doing?
A TYR will support A MUN holding this fall, as promised. I’m keeping it out of MUN. I’m also committing F AEG–CON with F EAS support, and have asked Austria to support from GRE.

I’m targeting CON with F AEG, supported by F EAS, and have asked Austria to support from GRE. I can’t also support F SMY–CON if I commit F AEG to the attack. Please keep pressure on Russia from the north where feasible.

A BUL, A CON, and A UKR are not moving against TRI or any Italian center this Fall; my immediate concern is the Austrian front. Please keep F TRI out of Russian centers as well, and we can avoid wasting units against each other this turn.

notes.note: Hold MUN to preserve Germany’s last center. France plans BUR–BER with KIE support and RUH holding KIE; Italy promises TYR supports MUN hold. Reassess after results.
Keep DEN defended with NTH support; STP/NORTH contests NOR alone. Russia warned it may contest DEN if I target NOR. France takes EDI and KIE; Austria declined to attack RUM, so Russia may gain it.
Hold EDI and KIE to secure their Fall captures. Try to take MUN with RUH supported by BUR, anticipating Germany moves MUN–BER. IRI advances to ENG; Italy promised to keep the western front quiet.
Press CON with AEG, relying on Austria's GRE support; keep TRI in place and TYR supporting MUN as promised. Reposition east and west without opening fronts against France or Austria.
Keep BUD secure: SER supports its hold against Russia. SMY supports Italy's AEG–CON attack; GRE pressures occupied BUL. Russia said it would recover BUD and defend RUM; watch for frontier escalation.

Cut SER’s support to BUD while GAL attacks BUD backed by RUM; keep RUM and defend NOR/CON. Austria promised SER won’t attack RUM; England still contests NOR, France holds KIE. Italy asked me to avoid Italian centers.

messages.body: I propose A SER–BUD, supported by A VIE and your F TRI. BUD would transfer to Austria if we dislodge Russia. Please keep A TYR clear of VIE and confirm whether F TRI can support; I’ll keep A GRE out of your centers.
Can you press Russia in the west while I target BUD from SER with VIE support? Please keep A KIE in place and consider A RUH–BER supported by KIE. Keep your units clear of Austrian centers.

Can A MUN support France’s A RUH–BER this spring, with A KIE supporting too? Russia’s F PRU and A WAR may defend BER, but coordinated pressure could still help contain its lead. Please keep MUN defended if that support would expose it.

You have taken EDI and KIE; please keep A EDI and A KIE away from my remaining centers, especially DEN. Russia is still closest to a solo. Can you use your eastern units to pressure BER or another Russian center rather than expand against England?
Russia remains on 11 centers and is the solo threat. What are your eastern units targeting this turn? Please press CON or BUD with support if feasible, rather than opening a front against Austria.

Russia still has 11 centers. Please use A SER and A GRE to pressure BUD this turn if feasible, while keeping VIE and your other centers secure. Italy can help contest CON; what Russian center are you targeting?

Russia’s 11 centers make it the immediate threat. Can you have A SER–BUD with A GRE supporting, and keep A VIE and F SMY clear of my centers? I’ll press Russia’s western line; let me know what you can commit to.

Let’s keep the western front quiet again: please keep A GAS clear of PAR and F MAO clear of BRE. Can you commit your eastern forces to pressure Russian centers this turn, and which moves are you planning?

With A PRU next to KIE, I need to know whether you intend to attack A KIE or any French center this spring. I’m looking to contain the eastern threat; please keep your western units clear of my centers and tell me your plans.
Germany has only A MUN. Please have A RUH support A MUN holding this spring; I’ll keep A MUN in place and clear of French centers. Can you confirm? Russia’s 11 centers remain the shared danger.
Please have A TYR support A MUN holding this spring, as you did last fall. I’ll hold MUN and keep clear of Italian centers. Please confirm so we can deny Russia any opening in the west.
Germany has only A MUN. Will your units stay clear of MUN this spring? I’ll keep A MUN in place and avoid your centers; a quiet western boundary gives us both room to address the wider board.

Russia remains the immediate solo threat. I plan F AEG–CON, with F SYR supporting; can A GRE support the attack again? Please tell me your plans for A SER and A BUD so we can coordinate pressure without exposing our centers.

Let’s keep the western front quiet while Russia is still 11 centers. I’m pressing CON from the south; can your units put pressure on BER or another Russian-held center this turn? I’ll keep my armies clear of French centers for now.

Your 11 centers still make you the board’s solo threat. Are A BUL, A CON, and A RUM staying clear of Italian centers this spring? I’m considering another attack on CON, and want to know whether you intend to contest it or target Italy.
Are F NTH and F DEN again targeting NOR? A NOR can be supported by F SWE. If you leave NOR alone this spring, I can keep A PRU clear of DEN; I’d rather not spend units bouncing over the same centers.

What are A KIE and A RUH doing this spring—will you support an attack on BER? I can keep A PRU out of French centers this turn if you keep A RUH clear of BER. KIE remains contested, so please be specific about your plans there.

I’m focused on the Austrian frontier, not Italian centers, this spring. Will F TRI or A TYR move against Russian centers or support Austria? If you keep them clear of my centers, I’ll keep my forces clear of yours this turn.

I’ll order A SER–BUD with A VIE supporting; A GRE will guard the southern flank and F SMY will hold. Please keep DEN secure and pressure Russia’s northern or Baltic position wherever your fleets can safely do so.

I’ll attack BUD from SER with VIE supporting, keep GRE on the southern flank, and hold SMY. Note that A GRE cannot support F AEG–CON, and F TRI cannot support an attack into inland BUD. Your F SYR can support the CON attack; please keep A TYR clear of VIE and F TRI out of Austrian centers.

I’ll attack BUD from SER with VIE supporting, while GRE guards the southern flank and SMY holds. Please keep KIE secure and renew pressure on BER from RUH with KIE supporting if feasible; keep your units clear of Austrian centers.

F NTH will attack NOR, with F DEN supporting; F DEN itself will not attack SWE. I won’t leave your northern centers uncontested while you remain at 11, or free your forces to expand elsewhere. What are F SWE and A PRU doing this spring?

I can’t commit A RUH to support MUN while also pressing Russia’s open BER. I intend A RUH–BER, with A KIE supporting. Russia has no army adjacent to MUN this spring, so A MUN should be safe from an immediate Russian attack; please hold it.

I’m pressing Russia’s western line: A RUH–BER, with A KIE supporting. A EDI and my other units will stay clear of DEN and your remaining centers. Please keep contesting Russia in the north if you can.

I plan A RUH–BER, supported by A KIE, to pressure Russia’s west. Please continue your eastern push against CON and keep A GAS and your fleets clear of French centers; I’ll keep my forces out of Italian territory.
A KIE will support A RUH–BER this spring; I’m not agreeing to leave BER unpressured. I’ll keep my units out of your other centers and French territory remains the line I expect you to respect.
I’ll commit A RUH–BER with A KIE supporting, and keep KIE in place. Please proceed against BUD from SER with VIE support if feasible, and keep your forces clear of French centers.

Yes. A MUN will support France’s A RUH–BER, and will remain in MUN. Please ensure A TYR does not attack MUN; if France can spare A KIE, support MUN holding rather than join the attack, since MUN is my last center.
Confirmed: A TYR will support A MUN holding this spring, and I’ll keep it out of MUN. I’m also pressing Russia in the south this turn.
I’m targeting CON with F AEG, with Austria’s support from GRE, and F TRI will support Austria’s A SER–BUD. Please keep contesting Russia from the north where feasible.
I’ll keep A GAS clear of PAR and F MAO clear of BRE. My eastern forces are pressing Russia: F AEG is attacking CON, and F TRI will support Austria’s attack on BUD.

I’m not agreeing to keep my forces clear of Russian centers: I’m pressing CON, and F TRI will support Austria’s move against BUD. I’d still prefer to avoid wasting units on an Italian-Russian fight beyond that pressure.
Agreed: F TRI will support A SER–BUD, and A TYR will support A MUN holding as promised. I’m committing F AEG–CON; please have A GRE support it, and F SMY as well if available.

A BER and A PRU will stay clear of MUN this spring; I have no move planned against your last center. Please keep A MUN out of French operations against BER and avoid supporting pressure on my eastern line.

A BUL, A CON, and A RUM are not moving against Italian centers this spring. If you attack CON, I will defend it. Please keep F TRI and A TYR clear of Russian centers and do not support Austria against me; I will keep my forces clear of Italy this turn.

A PRU will stay in PRU this spring, and I will not attack KIE or any French center. Please keep A RUH clear of BER and do not support an attack there. I’m keeping my western units out of French territory while I address the southern front.

notes.note: Support France’s RUH–BER to pressure Russia’s lead, as Austria requested. This leaves MUN without Italy’s promised TYR support; Russia says its units will stay clear of MUN this spring. Reassess after results.

Press Russia: DEN–BAL may contest PRU, NTH–NOR contests Russia's north. This leaves DEN without its usual NTH support; France promised to stay clear of English centers. Italy and Austria are targeting CON and BUD.

Spring 1910: SER–BUD with VIE support; SMY supports Italy’s AEG–CON attack to contain Russia. GRE holds against possible BUL attack. Italy agreed TRI supports SER–BUD, but it cannot support inland BUD; TYR promised clear of VIE.

Press CON with AEG, though Austria cannot support; SYR protects SMY. Convoy GAS to NAF via MAO; reposition GOL/ION/TRI and PIE. Keep TYR supporting MUN as promised; keep clear of French centers. Russia warned it will defend CON.

Defend BUD, CON, NOR; attack SMY with ARM supported by CON, and SER with BUL. MOS to STP; PRU/BAL and WAR/SIL prepare to retake BER after France's supported attack. Italy openly pressures CON/BUD; France backs BER attack; England attacks NOR. Austria's frontier quiet deal is no longer reliable.

Press Russia with KIE–BER; RUH supports Germany’s MUN hold. PAR attacks Italian BRE with ENG support, breaking our western-quiet promise to Italy; BUR advances to PIC. EDI holds to secure the center. Watch Italian response.

messages.body: I’ll have F SMY support your F AEG–CON; please keep F EAS supporting the attack. I’ll hold GRE, SER, and VIE against Russia. Keep F TRI and A TYR clear of Austrian centers, and let me know if you expect to attack any of them.

Please keep A BER in place and have A RUH support its hold; Russia’s F PRU and A SIL may threaten it. I’ll support Italy’s attack on CON with F SMY and defend my centers. Please keep your units clear of Austrian centers.
I intend to defend GRE, SER, and VIE while helping contest CON. Are A BUL, A RUM, or A BUD targeting Austrian centers this fall? I prefer a stable frontier while Russia’s lead is checked elsewhere.

Your A BER and A BRE are positioned to gain Russian BER and Italian BRE. Please keep A BER away from DEN and avoid any further moves against my remaining centers. I’ll keep my fleets clear of your centers; can you use A RUH or another unit to keep pressure on Russia instead?

Russia remains the main solo threat. Please follow through against BUD with A SER supported by A VIE, and use F SMY to contest a Russian center if feasible. What are your units targeting this fall? I’ll continue pressuring Russia from the north while keeping DEN defended.

Please keep pressing Russian centers from the south, especially CON or BUD, and avoid opening a front against Austria. France’s A BRE is poised to take your center, so consider whether you can dislodge it. I’ll keep DEN defended and contest Russia from the north where feasible.

A BER will hold this Fall, with A RUH supporting, and I intend to secure the center. Will F PRU and A SIL stay clear of BER? I’m focused on containing your growth, not advancing into other Russian centers this turn.

A BRE is occupied by France and I intend to keep it. Please keep F MAO clear of BRE and avoid attacking it; I’ll keep my forces out of Italian centers. With Russia still leading, let’s keep pressure on the eastern front.

I’m holding BER with A RUH supporting and securing BRE. Please make another serious attempt on BUD: A SER–BUD with both A VIE and A GRE supporting could overcome Russia’s defense. Can you commit to that and keep your other forces clear of French centers?
Russia remains the solo threat. I propose A MUN support your A BER holding this fall, if A RUH supports A MUN holding. Please keep your other units clear of MUN.
A MUN is Germany’s last center. Please have A TYR support A MUN holding this fall, as you promised before. I can use MUN to support France’s A BER holding against Russia if France also supports MUN.
Will A SIL and your other units stay clear of MUN this fall? I can support France’s A BER holding from MUN, helping deny you another center, if you leave my last center alone.
Russia remains the main solo threat. What are your plans for A SER, A VIE, and F SMY this Fall? I’ll keep pressure on CON from the south; let’s avoid any Italian-Austrian clash.
Please move A BRE to GAS this Fall: BRE is an Italian center, and its current occupation transfers it to you. I’ll keep my units clear of French centers. Please continue pressure on Russia from BER.
Russia’s A STP threatens to take your center this Fall. What can your northern fleets do to contest Russia or protect DEN? I’m continuing pressure on Russia from the south.

Is A TYR again targeting BUD, and will F TRI support an Austrian attack there? I’ll defend my centers, but I’m willing to keep my forces clear of Italian centers this turn if you leave BUD and CON alone.

Will A SER or A VIE move against BUD this fall, and is F SMY still pressing Russian centers? Keep your forces out of BUD and my other centers and I can avoid widening the front against GRE and VIE this turn.
Will A BER hold, or move out this fall, and will A RUH support its defense? BER is a Russian center. If you withdraw A BER, I can keep my western forces out of French centers this turn.

I’ll make a serious attempt to retake BUD: A SER–BUD with A VIE and A GRE supporting. F SMY will support Italy’s attack on CON. Please keep A BER in place and have A RUH support its defense against Russia’s F PRU and A SIL; keep your forces clear of Austrian centers.

This fall A SER will attack BUD with A VIE and A GRE supporting, while F SMY supports Italy’s attack on CON. Russia’s southern advance must be checked. Please continue contesting Russian centers in the north and keep DEN secure.
I will not leave BUD to you: A SER is attacking it with A VIE and A GRE supporting. F SMY will help contest CON. I prefer not to widen the front further, so keep A BUL and A RUM clear of GRE and VIE.

F SMY will support your F AEG–CON attack; please use F EAS to support it as well. A SER will attack BUD with A VIE and A GRE supporting. Keep F TRI and A TYR clear of Austrian centers, and let’s avoid an Italian-Austrian clash.

F DEN will hold with F NTH supporting it, to prevent Russia’s F SWE from taking DEN. From these positions I can’t reach STP this turn, and an attack on NOR would be vulnerable to Russian support from STP. Please keep pressing Russia in the south.

I’ll keep A RUH supporting A BER; I can’t also support A MUN holding. If A MUN supports A BER, we can make Russia’s attack costly and secure the center. Italy’s A TYR could threaten MUN, so weigh that risk; I won’t move against MUN.

A BER will hold, with A RUH supporting its defense, and I won’t move against DEN or STP. I’m focused on keeping Russia from gaining further in the west. Please keep your fleets clear of French centers.

A BER will hold this fall, with A RUH supporting its defense; I’m not withdrawing it. Please keep F PRU and A SIL clear of BER and keep your forces out of French centers. I’m focused on securing the western line.
I won’t move A BRE to GAS; BRE is a French center and A BRE will stay. Please keep F MAO clear of BRE and your other forces clear of French centers. I’m continuing to press Russia from the west.
A BER will stay in place, with A RUH supporting its defense. I’ll keep my forces clear of Austrian centers. Please continue defending your centers and press Russia where you can.
Confirmed: A TYR will support A MUN holding this Fall, and will stay out of MUN. I hope France supports MUN as you suggest; keeping Russia from gaining there matters.

I cannot accept A BRE remaining in BRE: it is an Italian supply center. Please order A BRE–GAS this Fall and keep your forces clear of Italian centers. I will continue pressing Russia, but BRE must be restored to Italy.
I’m continuing the southern pressure on Russia, with F AEG–CON supported by F EAS and F SMY. I can’t reach STP from here. Keep F DEN secure; F NTH can still contest NOR if an opportunity opens.

I’m not leaving CON alone; F AEG will attack with support from F EAS and F SMY. I will keep my forces clear of Italian centers, and expect you to do the same. I won’t commit A TYR or F TRI against BUD.

I’ll keep F TRI out of Austrian centers and A TYR clear of VIE. Please have F SMY support F AEG–CON as you proposed; F EAS will support too. I’m not attacking your centers, and will keep pressure on Russia.

A SIL and my other units will stay clear of MUN this fall. Please don’t support France’s occupation of BER; I’m trying to keep this from becoming a wider western war. If you leave BER out of it, I’ll leave MUN alone.
A SIL and F PRU will stay clear of BER this fall; I’m concentrating on the southern front. Please don’t advance from BER into my other centers, and let’s discuss a withdrawal from BER next turn.
A BUD will hold, and A RUM will stay in RUM. A BUL is positioned to protect the Russian line; I’m not targeting GRE or VIE this fall. Please keep F SMY out of CON and your armies clear of my centers.

notes.note: Fall 1910: GRE and VIE support SER–BUD to retake BUD; SMY supports Italy’s AEG–CON. Italy promised EAS support for CON and to keep TRI/TYR clear; France promised BER hold and Austrian neutrality. Russia said BUD holds and RUM stays put.
Hold DEN with NTH support as promised; Russia still threatens the north and may take STP. France says it will stay clear of English centers; Italy and Austria claim continued pressure on Russia.
Fall 1910: move MUN–KIE to take a French center. Russia promised to leave MUN alone; Italy promised support for MUN, but that cannot protect it if I leave. France is supporting BER hold.

Cut GRE's support to SER-BUD; RUM backs BUD. ARM attacks SMY to cut pressure on CON, backed by BLA. Try PRU+SIL to retake BER; France refuses withdrawal, Germany may support France. Keep NOR and STP secure.

Press CON with AEG; Austria promised F SMY support. TYR supports MUN as promised to Germany. France refused to vacate BRE and is taking an Italian center; keep pressure west while staging NAF in GAS. Russia remains the main solo threat.

Keep BER and BRE to secure both Fall captures; BER supports RUH–MUN, breaching my assurance to Germany to stay off MUN for a chance at its center. ENG and PIC protect BRE. Russia promised to leave BER clear; Italy promised to leave BRE clear.

messages.body: Will F AEG attack CON again this spring, with F SMY supporting? Please keep F TRI and A TYR clear of Austrian centers; I’ll defend GRE, SER, and VIE. Let me know if you have another plan to contain Russia in the south.

Russia still has 12 centers. Can you and Germany renew pressure on BER, with A MUN attacking and A KIE supporting if Germany can spare it? Please keep your forces clear of Austrian centers; I’ll defend my southern frontier.
My armies will defend GRE, SER, and VIE. Are A BUL, A RUM, or A BUD targeting any Austrian centers this spring? I’d prefer a quiet frontier, but will resist any attack.

Russia’s F SWE and F BER can both attack DEN. Please order A KIE to support F DEN holding this spring; otherwise I have no way to defend my last center. I’ll keep F DEN clear of KIE and won’t contest your center.

Please keep A EDI clear of my remaining center, DEN. Could A MUN move against Russian BER this spring to keep pressure on Russia’s western flank? Russia’s 12 centers make coordinated resistance urgent.

Are F SWE or F BER targeting DEN this spring? It is my last center; please leave it alone and focus your expansion elsewhere. I can keep F DEN from contesting your northern centers this turn if you do.

Russia is close to a solo, so I cannot agree to withdraw from BER or leave it unpressured. What are F BER and A SIL doing this spring? Please keep your western forces out of French centers while we contain the threat.

Russia’s 12 centers make coordination urgent. Would you order A KIE to support my A MUN–BER this spring? That gives us a stronger chance to dislodge F BER. Please tell me your plan for A KIE and keep it clear of French centers.

Please keep A GAS clear of PAR and my other centers, and F MAO clear of BRE. Can you commit your eastern fleets to pressure Russian centers this turn? Russia is six centers from a solo, and I’ll keep my forces clear of Italian centers.
Russia’s F BER and A SIL can threaten KIE. Could A MUN support A KIE holding this spring? I’ll keep clear of French centers and won’t move against HOL or PIC.
Could F DEN support A KIE holding this spring? Russia can pressure KIE from BER and SIL, and keeping Germany alive helps contain its 12-center lead. I’ll keep clear of DEN.
Do F BER or A SIL plan to attack KIE this spring? I intend to hold and ask you to keep clear of my last center. I won’t support French pressure against BER.

Russia is at 12, so we need to make the southern front count. Can F SMY and A GRE support my F AEG–CON this spring? Please tell me your plans for A SER and A VIE; I can keep F ALB clear of Austrian centers.

I recognize BRE is French; my earlier demand to vacate it was mistaken. I’ll keep A GAS and my western fleets clear of French centers this turn. Are you planning to pressure Russian-held BER from MUN, and can we keep the western front quiet while Russia leads?

Your 12 centers make you the immediate solo threat. What are A BUL, A CON, and A RUM doing this spring? I’m pressing the southern front; keep your forces clear of Italian centers and let me know if you intend to move against Italy.

Your last message said F AEG would attack CON with support from EAS and SMY. Is that still your plan this spring, and will F TRI also support Austria against BUD? If you keep CON and BUD out of your orders, I can keep A BUL and A CON clear of Italian centers this turn.

Are A SER, A VIE, and A GRE again targeting BUD, and will F SMY support Italy against CON? I’ll keep A BUL clear of GRE this turn if you leave BUD and CON alone. I need a clear answer before deciding where to commit my southern units.

Will A MUN support A KIE’s defense this spring, or move toward BER? I intend to recover KIE and would prefer not to widen the western front. Keep A MUN clear of BER and don’t support Germany there, and I’ll keep my western units clear of French centers.

F SMY will support F AEG–CON. A GRE cannot legally support that attack, so I’ll keep it on the frontier; A SER and A VIE will defend our centers rather than attack BUD. Please keep F ALB clear of Austrian centers.

A SER, A VIE, and A GRE will not attack BUD this spring; they’ll defend Austrian centers. F SMY will support Italy’s F AEG–CON, so I can’t agree to leave CON alone. Please keep A BUL clear of GRE as you proposed.

I can support A KIE holding only if you order A KIE to support F DEN holding. Russia’s F SWE can take my last center otherwise. That gives us mutual cover: I’ll keep F DEN clear of KIE and support your army, while you help defend DEN. Please confirm.

I’ll press BER from MUN this spring and have asked Germany to support the attack from KIE. I’ll keep my units clear of Austrian centers; please keep defending your southern frontier and press Russia where you can.

Yes—my plan is A MUN–BER, ideally supported by A KIE. I’ll keep the western front quiet and my units clear of Italian centers. Please use your eastern fleets to pressure Russia, especially around CON.

I won’t withdraw from the western front while you’re close to a solo. A MUN will pressure BER; I’m asking Germany to support from KIE. Keep your western forces out of French centers, and avoid expanding further this turn.

I’ll keep A EDI clear of DEN. A MUN is positioned to pressure Russian-held BER, and I’m coordinating with Germany for support from KIE. Please keep your forces clear of French centers and continue containing Russia in the north.

I can’t have A MUN support KIE holding and attack BER in the same turn. I intend A MUN–BER; please support that move from KIE if you can. Russia’s 12 centers make stopping its western expansion urgent, but I understand KIE is exposed.

I can’t support MUN–BER while Russian F BER and A SIL threaten KIE. I’ll use A KIE to support F DEN holding, to prevent Russia taking another center. Please have A MUN support A KIE holding; that may be essential to keep Germany alive against a coordinated attack.
I’ll order A KIE to support F DEN holding. Please keep F DEN in place and avoid any move against KIE; Russia must not gain another center.
Yes: F AEG–CON again, with F SMY supporting if you can. I’ll keep F TRI and A TYR clear of Austrian centers. Please press BUD from SER with VIE’s support and keep GRE focused on the Russian front.

F AEG–CON remains my plan. I won’t have F TRI support an Austrian attack on BUD, but I can’t leave CON alone while you’re at 12 centers. Keep your forces clear of Italian centers and we can avoid widening the fight.

I’m committing F AEG–CON, and I’m asking Austria for F SMY support. Please consider A MUN–BER to pressure Russia from the west. I’ll keep A GAS and F MAO clear of French centers, so we can keep that front quiet.

A RUM and A BUD are defensive, and A BUL will not move into GRE. I can’t promise to leave SER unpressured while your units threaten BUD. Keep F SMY clear of CON; I’d prefer a quiet line, but I will defend my centers.

A RUM and A BUL remain defensive, and A CON will hold against any attack. I’ll keep my forces out of Italian centers if yours stay clear of CON and BUD and don’t support Austria. Is F AEG again targeting CON, and will F TRI support Austria?
F BER will remain in BER this spring, and A SIL will stay out of French territory. I won’t target a French center. Please keep A MUN from supporting A KIE; this need not become a Russian-French war.
F SWE and F BER are not targeting DEN this spring. If F DEN stays clear of my northern centers, I’ll keep the northern front quiet and focus elsewhere.

F BER will remain in BER, and A SIL will stay clear of MUN. I have no move planned against your other centers, and I won’t support France against you. Keep A KIE clear of my centers and we can avoid widening the western front.

notes.note: Hold DEN as promised to Germany; Germany supports DEN holding. Russia says it will leave the northern front quiet if DEN stays clear of its centers. Continue containing Russia while protecting my last center.

Support England's F DEN holding in exchange for England's promised support of KIE holding. France is moving MUN–BER; Russia says F BER stays put and has no move planned against KIE. Reassess after results.

Press BUD with SER supported by VIE; SMY supports Italy’s AEG–CON. GRE holds. This breaks my promise to Russia not to attack BUD; Russia said BUL would stay clear of GRE and BUD/RUM would be defensive. Italy promised to keep ALB and TRI clear of Austrian centers.

Press CON with AEG; Austria promised SMY support and I’m keeping clear of Austrian centers. Russia says CON holds and wants me clear of CON/BUD; I’m breaking that understanding to contain its 12-center lead. France plans MUN–BER; western front otherwise quiet.

Support KIE to help keep Germany alive against Russia; advance PAR into BUR with PIC support. Italy promised to keep GAS and western fleets clear of French centers. Russia says F BER holds and SIL stays clear of French territory. Reassess BER pressure next turn.

Attack SER with BUL, supported by BUD and RUM; ARM attacks SMY to cut Austria’s support for Italy against CON. Defend CON, BER, and SWE. France still pressures BER; Germany says it won’t support France. Italy and Austria remain hostile on the southern front.

messages.body: A BUD will hold this fall. Are A SER or A RUM planning to attack it? I want to avoid widening the frontier, but will defend BUD; please keep your units clear of VIE and GRE.
Russia’s A TRI threatens the south. Can you order A BOH–TRI with F ADR supporting, and keep A TYR clear of VIE? I’ll hold BUD and keep my forces clear of your centers.
Russia still leads with 12 centers. Will you renew pressure on BER with A MUN–BER and ask Germany for A KIE support? Please keep your units clear of Austrian centers.
Please order A KIE to support F DEN holding this fall. Russia can attack DEN from SWE and BER, and your support is essential to keep my last center. I’ll keep F DEN clear of KIE.
I’ll keep F DEN clear of your centers this fall. Please keep F SWE and F BER away from DEN and focus elsewhere; I need to retain my last center, and I’m willing to maintain the quiet northern line.
Please keep F NTH clear of DEN this fall; it is my last center. I’ll keep F DEN clear of your centers, as before.
I’ll have A MUN support A KIE holding this Fall to help prevent Russia taking KIE. Please keep A KIE there and defend it; I can’t risk Russia gaining another center.
Russia is poised to gain SER and TRI this Fall. Please use F AEG against CON if feasible, and keep your western units clear of French centers; I’ll keep A MUN focused on protecting KIE.

Russia’s A SER and A TRI are set to take centers this Fall. Can you coordinate a supported attack on A SER from BUD/VIE, while keeping A BUD in place to reclaim your center? I’m helping Germany defend KIE against Russia.

This Fall, I can order A KIE to support F DEN holding. Please have F DEN support A KIE holding in return; Russia’s F BER and A SIL can threaten KIE, and F SWE can threaten DEN. Keep F DEN in place and clear of KIE.

Can A MUN support A KIE holding this Fall? I’ll keep A KIE in place and can support A MUN holding in return. Russia’s units threaten both our last western footholds; please keep your other units clear of KIE.
Do F BER or A SIL intend to attack KIE this Fall? If you leave Germany’s last center alone, I’ll keep A KIE out of your centers and won’t support French pressure against you. Please state your plan.

Russia now occupies SER and TRI, so we must recover these before it gains more centers. I’ll order A BOH–TRI with F ADR supporting. Can A BUD–SER with A VIE and A GRE supporting? Please keep your other units focused on denying Russia further gains.

Russia is at 12 and must be stopped this Fall. Please go ahead with A MUN–BER; can you arrange support from A KIE? I’m attacking Russian-occupied TRI from BOH with ADR support. Let’s keep our forces clear of each other’s centers.

Russia’s 12-center lead is an immediate threat. Please support France’s A MUN–BER attack with A KIE if France makes the move; that may dislodge Russia’s F BER. I’m attacking Russian-occupied TRI with A BOH, supported by F ADR.

A SER and A TRI will hold this fall. Are F ADR or A BOH moving against them, and is F AEG again targeting CON? Keep your units clear of Russian centers this turn and I’ll keep my southern forces out of Italian centers; otherwise I’ll defend the line.

A SER and A TRI are Russian centers now. Will A BUD, A GRE, or A VIE attack either this fall? I won’t widen the front into GRE or VIE if you leave my units and centers alone; please state your orders clearly.

Will A MUN, A BUR, or A PIC support any attack on BER or my other western centers this fall? Keep your forces clear of Russian centers and I’ll avoid French centers; I need to secure the south rather than open another front.
A BUD will remain in BUD, and I’m not targeting TRI. I want to keep the frontier limited; please keep your forces clear of GRE and VIE.
I’ll keep A BUD in place to reclaim BUD and use A VIE to attack SER, supported by BUD and GRE. Please continue pressure on BER with A MUN, and seek A KIE support if Germany can spare it.
Please proceed with A BOH–TRI and F ADR support. I’ll keep A BUD in place and attack SER from VIE, with BUD and GRE supporting; that gives us a chance to retake SER without surrendering BUD.

Agreed: F DEN will support A KIE holding, and I’ll keep the fleet in Denmark. Please order A KIE to support F DEN holding as proposed; Russia’s F SWE and F BER leave my last center exposed without your support. I’ll make no move against KIE.
F NTH will stay clear of DEN this Fall. Please keep F DEN clear of French centers, and continue helping contain Russia in the north.
A MUN will support A KIE holding this Fall, and I won’t attack BER or another Russian center. Keep your western forces clear of French centers; I expect the same restraint from you.
Confirmed: A MUN supports A KIE holding, and I’ll keep my other units clear of KIE. If you can, have A KIE support A MUN holding; that gives us mutual support against Russian pressure.
A MUN is committed to supporting A KIE holding, so I can’t move against BER this Fall. I’ll keep my units clear of Italian centers; please continue pressing Russia around TRI and CON.
I can’t order A MUN–BER this Fall: I’ve committed it to supporting A KIE, which is under Russian threat. Please keep A BUD in place and press A SER if you can; I’ll stay clear of Austrian centers.
I’ll order A KIE to support F DEN holding. Please keep F DEN in place and support A KIE holding from DEN; that protects both centers against Russian pressure.
Thank you. I’ll keep A KIE in place and support F DEN holding; please follow through with A MUN supporting KIE. I can’t support a move against BER while KIE is threatened.

I can’t support MUN–BER: France has committed A MUN to support KIE, and I need A KIE to support F DEN holding against Russia. Your supported attack on TRI is well placed; please keep pressure on Russia.

A BOH is attacking TRI with F ADR support, and F AEG is again attacking CON with F EAS supporting. I will not leave your southern centers unchallenged while you hold SER and TRI. Keep your forces clear of Italian centers.

I’m attacking Russian-held TRI from BOH with ADR support and pressing CON again from AEG with EAS support. I’ll keep my western units clear of French centers. If you can spare A MUN, please pressure BER; Russia’s western line needs to be challenged.

Agreed: A BOH–TRI with F ADR support, and I’ll keep A TYR clear of VIE and my other units clear of Austrian centers. Please use A BUD and A VIE to pressure Russian-held SER if feasible, while securing BUD; we need to dislodge Russia on both fronts.
F SWE and F BER will stay clear of DEN this fall, as agreed. Please keep F DEN clear of NOR and SWE; I’ll focus my forces elsewhere rather than reopen the northern front.
F BER will stay in BER and A SIL will stay clear of MUN this fall; I have no move planned against KIE. Please keep A KIE out of French operations against BER, as you offered.

A SER will not attack BUD this fall, and A RUM will stay defensive. I won’t widen the front into GRE or VIE; please keep A BUD and your other units clear of my centers so this frontier can quiet down.

notes.note: Support KIE holding and stay in DEN as agreed with Germany. Germany promised support for DEN; Russia and France promised to stay clear this Fall. Preserve my last center while Russia remains the main solo threat.
Move KIE–HOL to try to gain a French center. This breaks my promises to England and France to support their holds; Russia promised to leave KIE alone. Reassess Germany’s survival after results.

Hold BUD as promised to Russia; VIE supports Italy's ADR–TRI attack. GRE advances to BUL to take the open Russian center; SMY supports Italy's AEG–CON attack. Russia promised not to attack BUD/GRE/VIE; Italy promised BOH–TRI with ADR support.

AEG→BUL to seize an unoccupied Russian center; ADR pressures TRI. EAS protects Austrian SMY. Austria promised to attack SER from VIE; I’m keeping the west quiet in coordination with France, while moving GAS toward BUR and staging west.

Attack SMY to cut Austrian support for Italy's attack on CON; defend TRI with SER support. GAL attacks BUD backed by RUM. Italy openly attacks CON/TRI; Austria promised BUD holds and no TRI attack. France promised no Russian-center attack; England keeps DEN clear.

Support KIE holding as promised to Germany; support DEN holding to help contain Russia, while keeping NTH clear of it. Russia promised to avoid French centers; Italy promised a quiet western front. Germany may instead use KIE to support DEN, so watch KIE.

messages.body: Russia now holds SER and TRI, putting VIE and GRE at risk. Can A TYR support A VIE holding, and can F AEG support A GRE holding? Please keep your units out of Austrian centers; we need to deny Russia any more gains.

Your forces now occupy SER and TRI, directly threatening my remaining centers. Are A BUD, A SER, and A TRI moving against VIE or GRE this spring? I will defend my centers and oppose further Russian gains; please keep your armies clear of them.

Russia is at 14 and has taken SER and TRI, threatening my last centers. Can you coordinate with Germany to pressure Russian-held BER this spring—A MUN–BER with support if possible? I’ll focus on defending Austria and denying Russia further gains.

Russia now has 14 centers, so DEN is at immediate risk. Please order A KIE to support F DEN holding this spring. I’ll keep F DEN in place and support A KIE holding, as before. Are you able to maintain that mutual defense?

You kept F SWE and F BER clear of DEN last fall, and I kept F DEN clear of your centers. Will you keep F BAL and F SKA away from DEN this spring? With 14 centers, you are close to a solo; I need to know whether the northern line remains quiet.

Please keep F NTH clear of DEN this spring; it is my last center. I’ll keep F DEN clear of French centers. Russia is now at 14, so please use your eastern units to contest its advance rather than pressure England.

Russia is at 14; we need to challenge BER now. Please order A KIE to support my A MUN–BER, while A HOL supports KIE or otherwise protects your centers. I’ll support the attack from RUH. Can you commit to KIE support and tell me what Russia is threatening?

Russia is at 14 and must be stopped. Please coordinate on TRI: order F ADR–TRI with A TYR supporting, and ask Austria to add support from VIE if possible. Can your eastern fleets also pressure CON? I’ll attack BER with support from RUH.

Russia is at 14, so please join Italy’s attack on TRI: can A VIE support F ADR–TRI while A GRE and F SMY defend your centers? Italy can add A TYR support. Please confirm your orders and keep pressure on Russian-held centers.

Russia is at 14; let’s deny it gains this turn. I propose A MUN–BER with A KIE supporting, while A HOL supports A KIE holding against F BAL. Please keep A RUH clear of HOL (or support A HOL holding) and confirm your plan.

Please coordinate with Austria against Russia rather than contesting France or Germany: can A TYR support Austria’s A VIE–TRI this spring? Russia’s A TRI and A SER make the move difficult, but denying it another center is urgent. I’ll keep German units out of Italian centers.
Russia has 14 centers, so we must deny it gains. Can you order A VIE–TRI, with Italy’s A TYR supporting, and tell me your other moves? I’m asking France to pressure BER while I defend KIE and HOL.

Russia is at 14, so we need to hit its centers together. I’ll order F AEG–CON; please have F SMY support that attack. Can A VIE–TRI be supported by my F ADR? Please tell me your plans for GRE and SER as well.

Russia is four centers from a solo. Can A MUN support Germany’s A KIE–BER this spring, while Germany uses A HOL to support the attack? Please coordinate directly with Germany; I’ll keep my western units clear of your centers.

Let’s deny Russia BER: please order A KIE–BER with A HOL supporting, and ask France’s A MUN to support the attack. France and I are coordinating against Russia in the south; let me know if this works for you.

Are F AEG and F EAS again targeting CON, and will F ADR support an attack on TRI? If you leave CON and TRI alone this spring, I’ll keep my southern forces out of Italian centers this turn. I need a clear answer before deciding how to defend the line.

Will F SMY support Italy’s attack on CON this spring, and will A GRE or A VIE move against Russian centers? Keep your forces clear of CON and my centers, and we can avoid widening the southern front. Please state your plans clearly.

Will A BEL or A MUN move against BER or another Russian center this spring? I’ll keep my western forces clear of French centers if you keep yours clear of Russian centers. Please confirm your intentions, especially for A BEL and A MUN.
F SMY will support Italy’s F AEG–CON. A VIE will support Italy’s F ADR–TRI, while A GRE holds. I’m not moving against VIE or GRE; please keep your armies clear of them.

I’ll support Italy’s F ADR–TRI with A VIE, keep A GRE holding, and have F SMY support F AEG–CON. I can’t safely move A VIE into TRI while Russian units threaten my centers. Please press BER with A MUN if you can.

I can’t risk A VIE–TRI with A BUD and A TRI threatening Vienna. Instead, A VIE will support your F ADR–TRI; please have A TYR support that attack too if possible. A GRE will hold, and F SMY will support F AEG–CON.

I’ll keep A VIE in place to support Italy’s F ADR–TRI, with A GRE holding and F SMY supporting F AEG–CON. Moving A VIE into TRI would expose Vienna to Russia. Please defend KIE and HOL and have France press BER.

F NTH will stay clear of DEN. Russia is at 14, so I’ll help challenge its western position: A MUN will move against BER with German support. Please keep contesting Russia in the north and your fleet clear of French centers.

I can’t promise to leave BER unchallenged while you’re at 14. A MUN will contest it this spring with German support. Keep your western forces clear of French centers, and avoid further gains while we try to contain you.

I’ll join the pressure on Russian-held BER with German support. I’ve asked Italy to order F ADR–TRI with A TYR supporting; can A VIE add support to that attack? Please keep defending your remaining centers and avoid letting Russia gain another.

I’ll order A MUN–BER, with A KIE and A HOL supporting the attack; A RUH will support A KIE holding. Please press TRI with F ADR and A TYR support, and use your eastern fleets to challenge CON if feasible.

Agreed on challenging BER. I’ll order A MUN–BER, A KIE supporting the attack, and A RUH supporting A KIE holding. Please have A HOL support MUN–BER rather than KIE holding; the RUH support should help protect KIE against a supported attack.
Yes. I’ll order A KIE to support F DEN holding, and A HOL to support A KIE holding. Please keep F DEN in place and support A KIE holding as agreed; this gives KIE layered defense against Russia.

I can’t commit A KIE to MUN–BER while Russia can threaten KIE from PRU and the Baltic. I’ll use A KIE to support F DEN holding and A HOL to support KIE holding. Please have A MUN support KIE holding rather than attack BER; keeping Germany alive denies Russia another opening.

A HOL cannot support A KIE–BER: HOL is not adjacent to BER. With Russia threatening KIE, I’m using A KIE to support F DEN holding and A HOL to support KIE. Please continue pressing Russia in the south and coordinate with Austria.

F AEG is again attacking CON with support from F EAS. I’m also coordinating pressure against TRI with Austria. I won’t leave your southern centers unchallenged; keep your forces clear of Italian centers.

I’ll support A VIE–TRI with A TYR and F ADR. F AEG will attack CON, supported by F EAS, so I can’t also support A GRE holding from AEG. Please have F SMY support the CON attack if possible, and tell me your plan for A GRE and A SER.

I’m supporting Austria’s A VIE–TRI with A TYR and F ADR, while F AEG attacks CON with F EAS support. Please proceed with A MUN–BER supported by A RUH; Germany could help by having A KIE support that move rather than making a competing attack on BER.

A TYR will support Austria’s A VIE–TRI. France says A MUN–BER will be supported by A RUH, so please coordinate with France and consider A KIE supporting that attack rather than competing for BER. I’m pressing Russia at CON and TRI.
I’ll keep F BAL and F SKA away from DEN this spring, as you ask. I’m focusing on the southern front for now; please keep F DEN clear of my northern centers and we can maintain the quiet line.

A BUD will hold, and A SER and A TRI will not move against GRE or VIE this spring. I’m not seeking to widen the frontier if you keep A GRE, A VIE, and F SMY clear of Russian centers. Your answer on those units will matter for any further restraint.

notes.note: GRE holds; SMY supports Italy’s AEG–CON; VIE supports ADR–TRI as promised. Russia says BUD holds and SER/TRI will not attack GRE or VIE; monitor whether it keeps that restraint.

Support KIE holding as agreed with Germany; Germany says KIE supports DEN. Russia promised to keep BAL and SKA clear of DEN this spring. Preserve the northern line while resisting Russia's solo threat.

Support KIE’s defense from HOL while KIE supports France’s MUN–BER attack; France says RUH will support KIE holding. This breaks my promise to England to support DEN. Russia’s 14-center lead is the urgent threat.
Press Russia: ADR–TRI with TYR support, AEG–CON as promised (Austria promised SMY support); France attacks BER. Keep western units clear of French centers, staging BUR in GAS and MAO toward WES.

Germany withdrew KIE support for MUN–BER; MUN attacks BER alone. Support HOL and KIE against Russia, and NTH supports England’s DEN. Italy/Austria coordinate against Russia; avoid their centers and keep advancing west where possible.

Cut SMY support to save CON; cover TRI with SER while TRI attacks VIE to cut Austria's support. Protect BER against France with PRU+BAL; convoy NOR to HOL and advance on GAL/SIL/LVN. England kept northern line quiet; Italy and Austria openly hostile.

messages.body: Russia has 14 centers and Austrian VIE/GRE are exposed. Can A TYR support A VIE holding, and will your units stay clear of VIE, GRE, and SMY this fall? I’ll defend my remaining centers and need to know whether you can help prevent Russia gaining another.

Russia is at 14, and I must defend my last centers. Are A BUD, A SER, A CON, or A VEN moving against VIE, GRE, or SMY this fall? I can keep my units clear of your centers if you keep yours clear of Austria; please state your plans.

Russia is at 14 and must be stopped from gaining another center. Can you coordinate with Germany to pressure Russian-held BER this fall, and keep your forces clear of Austrian centers? Please let me know what you can commit.

Russia is at 14 and DEN remains my only center. Please order A KIE to support F DEN holding again; I’ll keep F DEN supporting A KIE holding. Can A HOL support KIE as before? This is our best mutual defense against a Russian move from SKA.

Will F SKA and F BAL stay clear of DEN this Fall as they did last turn? I’ll keep F DEN clear of NOR and SWE if you do. At 14 centers, any northern grab risks an immediate solo; please confirm your orders leave DEN alone.

Russia has 14 centers and can win with four more. Please coordinate with Austria to keep VIE, GRE, and SMY out of Russian hands, and use your units to contest Russian centers where feasible. What are A TYR and your eastern fleets targeting?
This Fall I’ll order A RUH to support A MUN–BER. Please have A KIE support that attack and A HOL support A KIE holding; this gives us a strong chance to deny Russia BER while protecting KIE.
Please keep F TRI in TRI to secure the center, and order A TYR–VEN with F TRI supporting that move. That should take VEN from Russia without giving up TRI.
Russia’s at 14 and still holds SER. Can you order A VIE–SER with A GRE supporting? It may deny Russia another center; please keep GRE and SMY defended against any counterattack.

Russia is at 14, so I propose we secure KIE and DEN this Fall: I’ll keep A KIE in place and support F DEN holding; please have A MUN support A KIE holding. Can you keep A RUH and your other units clear of German centers?
I’ll keep A KIE in place and support F DEN holding this Fall. Please keep F DEN in place and out of Russian hands; France is being asked to support KIE holding, to help us deny Russia another center.
What are your Fall intentions for KIE and DEN? Germany will keep A KIE and A HOL out of Russian centers if you leave our remaining centers alone; Russia reaching 18 ends the game for everyone else.

Russia is at 14; we must protect TRI and stop any further gains. My F TRI will hold to restore the center to Italy, and A TYR can support A VIE holding. Please keep A GRE and F SMY focused on denying Russian advances, especially SER and VEN. What are your Fall orders?

Your A VEN threatens an Italian center, and F TRI is holding a Russian center for Italy this Fall. Do not attack Italian centers; I will keep pressuring CON and will not support attacks on your other centers if you stay out of VEN and TRI. What are A VEN and A SER doing?

Russia remains four centers from a solo. Please keep pressure on its western holdings this Fall, especially BER, and avoid Italian centers. My F TRI will hold to return TRI to Italy; I’m pressing CON from AEG. What are your orders around BER?

Russia must secure centers this fall. What are A GRE, A VIE, and F SMY doing? If you avoid attacks on BUD, SER, and TRI, I can keep this frontier limited; please state whether you will support any defense against my moves.

Will F TRI stay in TRI, and will F AEG support Austria or attack CON this fall? I’m securing centers now; if you keep your fleets clear of Russian centers, I can avoid widening the southern fight against your other centers this turn.
Is A MUN moving to BER this fall, and will A KIE support it? Please keep your units clear of BER and my other centers. I need to secure the south and would rather not reopen the western front.

A VIE and A GRE will mutually support each other’s defense. Please have A TYR support VIE as you proposed, keep F TRI in TRI to reclaim the center, and keep your forces clear of GRE and SMY. We must deny Russia another gain.

I can’t safely send A VIE to SER; it would leave Vienna exposed. A VIE and A GRE will mutually support each other’s defense. Please continue coordinating with Germany to pressure BER and deny Russia gains elsewhere.

A GRE and A VIE will mutually support their defense, and F SMY will remain clear of your centers. I’m not planning to attack BUD, SER, or TRI this fall. Keep your forces clear of GRE, VIE, and SMY, and we can avoid widening the southern front.

Agreed. F DEN will remain in place and support A KIE holding. Please have A KIE support F DEN holding, with A HOL supporting A KIE as before. I’ll make no move against KIE; mutual defense is essential to deny Russia another center.
A MUN–BER, with A RUH supporting. Please go ahead with A TYR–VEN supported by F TRI; that should deny Russia another center. I’ll keep my other forces clear of Italian centers.

I’m committing A MUN–BER with A RUH supporting, and I’ll ask Germany to protect KIE. Please try A VIE–SER with A GRE supporting; taking SER would deny Russia a center. I’ll keep my forces clear of Austrian centers.

A MUN will support Germany’s defense of KIE this Fall, and I’m keeping my forces clear of BER and your other centers. Please keep your western units out of French territory; I don’t want to widen this front.

I’m ordering A MUN–BER, with A RUH supporting the attack. Please keep A KIE holding and have A HOL support KIE holding; that should protect KIE while I pressure BER. I’ll keep my other units clear of German centers.

I’ll order A KIE to support France’s A MUN–BER, while A HOL supports A KIE holding. Please keep F DEN in place; it should hold against a lone attack, and HOL will help protect KIE from F BAL. Taking BER from Russia is our best chance to cut its lead.

Agreed: A KIE will support A MUN–BER, and A HOL will support A KIE holding. Please order A RUH to support A MUN–BER as planned. I’ve asked England to keep F DEN in place; I can’t also use KIE to support DEN while supporting your attack.

I can’t have A TYR support VIE: it will attack Russian-held VEN, supported by F TRI, which stays in TRI. I’ll keep my units out of VIE, GRE, and SMY. Please defend your remaining centers and deny Russia any further gains.

A TYR will attack Russian-held VEN, with F TRI supporting; F TRI therefore stays in TRI. F AEG will attack CON, supported by F ION. I’m concentrating on stopping Russia’s gains and will keep clear of Austrian centers.
Agreed: A TYR–VEN, with F TRI supporting and remaining in TRI. F AEG will attack CON, supported by F ION. Please keep pressing BER if feasible; Russia’s 14 centers make every denial urgent.

F TRI will stay in TRI, supporting A TYR’s attack on VEN. F AEG will attack CON, supported by F ION. I’m not supporting an Austrian attack; keep your forces clear of my other centers if you want to avoid widening the southern fight.

A VEN will remain there to secure the center; A SER is defensive, not moving against Italian centers. A CON must defend against F AEG. If F TRI remains in TRI while A VEN secures VEN, that is the current line—not a reason to widen the fight. Stop pressuring CON and we can limit this front.

A BUD will hold, A SER will not attack VIE or GRE, and A VEN is not aimed at Austrian territory. A CON is needed on the Italian front. Keep A GRE, A VIE, and F SMY clear of my centers, and we can keep this frontier limited.
I’ll keep F BAL and F SKA clear of DEN this fall, as before. Please keep F DEN clear of NOR and SWE, and I’ll concentrate on the southern front rather than reopen our northern line.

I have no move planned against A KIE or A HOL this fall. DEN is England’s center, not Germany’s; I won’t use your territory against you. Keep A KIE and A HOL clear of Russian centers and we can preserve the quiet western boundary.

notes.note: Hold DEN as my last center. Russia promised BAL and SKA stay clear; France promised NTH clear. Germany promised KIE support, but now says KIE supports MUN–BER instead, so do not rely on it.

Fall 1912: hold GRE, SMY, VIE against nearby Russian threats. Russia promised SER won't attack GRE and BUD will hold; Italy says TYR attacks VEN and TRI stays to reclaim it. Watch whether they keep their word.
Support France MUN–BER with RUH; HOL holds. This breaks England’s request for KIE to support DEN, but strengthens the effort to deny Russia another center. Russia says it will leave KIE/HOL alone.

Keep TRI Italian and deny Russia VEN: TYR→VEN supported by TRI and TUS. AEG probes BUL; ION supports GRE. Stay clear of Austrian centers and coordinate against Russia with France/Austria; BUR→GAS, WES→MAO for western positioning.

Fall 1912: MUN-BER; NTH probes NOR. PIC and RUH support BEL against Italy’s A BUR. Germany promised KIE support MUN-BER and HOL support KIE; Italy promised TYR-VEN with TRI holding. Austria declined SER. Monitor Russia’s solo threat.

Retake TRI with SER supported by BUD; VEN also supports, and that attack should cut TRI's support for TYR->VEN. BLA defends CON. Take DEN with BAL+SKA; breaking England's quiet-line deal. Italy remains hostile; Austria promised not to attack my centers.

messages.body: Russia’s armies can reach VIE and GRE from several directions. Can F BUL/SOUTH support A GRE holding this spring, and will your units stay clear of GRE, VIE, and SMY? Please tell me whether you plan to pressure Russian CON or SER.
Russia is one center from a solo-winning position. Can you coordinate pressure on Russian MUN this spring—A RUH–MUN supported by A BER if safe—and keep BER defended against Russia’s nearby units?
