Your forces are close to VIE and GRE, and Russia is at 14. Are A BUD, A TRI, A SER, or A CON moving against Austrian centers this spring? If you keep clear of VIE and GRE, I will avoid attacking your centers this turn; please state your intentions.
Russia is at 14 and I intend F SWE–DEN this turn. Can F NTH support that attack? Please also keep pressure on Russian-held BER rather than spend units against England; let me know your plan.

I’m attacking Russian-held DEN with F SWE. Can A KIE support F SWE–DEN? Russia’s southern push is the immediate solo threat; please avoid any move that helps Russia gain another center and tell me what A HOL will do.

Russia is at 14 and needs only four centers to win. Please keep F BUL/SOUTH and F ION focused on CON, and coordinate with Austria to deny Russia BUD, TRI, VIE, GRE, or SMY. What Russian center are you targeting this turn?
Russia is still 14, so we need to deny its next gains. I propose A BER–MUN with A RUH supporting and A KIE supporting the attack; please have A HOL support A KIE holding. Can you commit to that?

Russia remains four centers from a solo. Please order F ADR–TRI this spring to contest Russia’s A TRI, and use F BUL/SOUTH or another unit to support if possible. I’ll press MUN from BER; please keep your western forces clear of French centers.

Russia is still at 14. Can A VIE support Italy’s F ADR–TRI this spring while A GRE and F SMY defend your centers? Italy can attack from ADR; I’m pressing MUN from BER. Please confirm whether you can support the TRI attack.

Russia’s 14 centers make holding the west urgent. I’ll order A HOL support A KIE holding and A KIE hold. Can A BER support KIE holding, with A RUH and A BEL supporting BER holding? Please tell me your plan; Russian A MUN and A PRU threaten both centers.

Please keep pressure on Russia this turn: can F ADR support A VEN–TRI, and can you coordinate with Austria for a second attack on TRI? Russia’s 14-center lead is an immediate solo threat. I’ll focus on keeping KIE and HOL out of its hands.

Russia is at 14; please coordinate with Italy to attack Russian-held TRI this turn. Can A VIE move to TRI, with Italian support, or otherwise help dislodge Russia there? I’ll defend KIE and HOL against the western threat.
Russia is four centers from a solo. I propose A VEN–TRI, with F ADR and your A VIE and A GRE supporting. Please keep your remaining units defending VIE, GRE, and SMY; can you commit those supports?

We need to deny Russia before it reaches 18. Please coordinate with England on F NTH–NOR, supported by F SWE, and use your armies to pressure Russian-held MUN/PRU where feasible. I’m organizing a supported attack on TRI with Austria.

Can F SWE support France’s F NTH–NOR this spring? Russia is close to a solo, and a coordinated attack on NOR could force it to divert units. Please coordinate directly with France and avoid exposing SWE.

Italy’s pressure on CON remains the immediate danger. Will F SMY and A GRE stay out of attacks or support against CON this spring? If so, I can keep A BUD clear of VIE and focus on the southern front. Please state what each unit will do.

Will F ION or F BUL/SOUTH attack or support an attack on CON this spring, and where is A VEN moving? If you are willing to leave CON and TRI alone, say so; after repeated attacks, I need a clear commitment before deciding whether to widen the southern fight.

I’ll keep my western units clear of French centers this spring. Will A BEL, A RUH, and A BER stay clear of MUN and my other centers? Please confirm your plans so we can keep the western front contained.

I can’t assist directly against MUN from Austria. I’m coordinating an attack on Russian-held TRI with Italy while keeping my centers covered. Please press MUN from RUH with BER support if safe, and keep BER defended; Russia’s western units make that pressure important.

I’m coordinating with Italy against TRI: A VIE will support A VEN–TRI, while A GRE supports VIE holding and F SMY supports GRE holding. That gives Italy a strong attack without leaving my centers undefended. Please defend KIE and HOL, and urge France to press MUN.

I’ll have A VIE support A VEN–TRI, but A GRE cannot also support the attack safely: it will support A VIE holding, and F SMY will support A GRE holding. With your A VEN and F ADR, the attack still has strength three. Keep your units clear of my centers.

F SMY and A GRE will not support an attack on CON. I’m using them to cover my centers while A VIE supports Italy’s attack on TRI. Please keep A BUD clear of VIE as you said, and keep A SER clear of GRE; I’m not attacking BUD or SER.

I can’t safely support F NTH–NOR from SWE: Russia’s F DEN and F SKA can combine against SWE, putting my last center at risk. F SWE will hold. Please coordinate with France on the NOR attack and keep pressing Russia from the south.

I’ll order A RUH–MUN with A BER supporting the attack, and A BEL will support A BER holding. That pressures Russia while helping keep BER secure. Please continue coordinating the attack on TRI and defend GRE and SMY.
Yes. F NTH will support F SWE–DEN. I’ll also keep pressure on Russian-held MUN with A RUH, supported by A BER; A BEL will support BER holding. Please go ahead with the move on DEN.

I can’t have A BER support both KIE and A RUH–MUN. I’ll use A BER to support the attack on MUN, while A BEL supports A BER holding and A RUH moves. Please keep A KIE in place and have A HOL support KIE holding.

I’ll pressure MUN with A RUH–MUN, supported by A BER, and A BEL will support BER holding. England intends F SWE–DEN, so F NTH will support that attack rather than move to NOR. Please coordinate your TRI attack with Austria.

I’ll keep A BEL clear of your centers, but I can’t promise that A BER and A RUH will stay clear of MUN. Russia’s position is too close to a solo for me to leave its western front unchallenged. I have no intention of moving against French centers.

I can’t have A KIE support BER–MUN while A HOL supports KIE holding: once KIE moves, that hold support is invalid. Russia can attack KIE from MUN or PRU, so I’ll keep KIE in place and HOL supporting it. Please have A BER support KIE holding and keep A RUH clear of German centers.

I can’t support F SWE–DEN from KIE without leaving KIE exposed; Russia can attack KIE from MUN or PRU. I’ll keep A KIE in place and A HOL supporting it. Please attack DEN if you can, but don’t count on German support this turn.

Yes: F ADR–TRI, with A VIE supporting. F BUL/SOUTH will attack CON. Please press Russian MUN from BER with RUH support if feasible, and coordinate the NTH–NOR attack with England. My western units will stay clear of French centers.

I’ll use F ION to support A GRE holding, so GRE is covered; F BUL/SOUTH will attack CON. Please have F SMY support that attack and A VIE support F ADR–TRI. I’ll keep my units out of VIE, GRE, and SMY.

F BUL/SOUTH will attack CON, and F ADR will attack TRI with Austrian support. F ION cannot support CON from its current sea, so I’m using it to support A GRE holding. Please coordinate your F SWE support for France’s F NTH–NOR.

F ADR will attack TRI, not support an attack from VEN; I’m coordinating with Austria for A VIE support. F BUL/SOUTH will attack CON. Please keep KIE and HOL secure and coordinate with France to pressure Russian MUN or PRU; I’ll stay clear of your centers.

No: F BUL/SOUTH will attack CON, and F ADR will contest TRI with Austrian support. I’m not agreeing to leave your southern centers alone. I see no A VEN in the current unit list; your A TRI is the target.

A BUD will hold and stay clear of VIE; A TRI will hold rather than attack GRE or VIE. There is no Russian unit in SER. A CON will defend against Italy. Please keep F SMY clear of support against CON and A GRE from supporting Italy, and I’ll keep the Austrian frontier quiet this spring.

notes.note: Spring 1913: F SWE–DEN with France's promised NTH support, challenging Russia's 14-center lead. Germany cannot support; protect SWE in Fall if feasible. Italy says CON/TRI pressure; France attacks MUN.

Hold KIE with HOL support to resist Russian pressure; France says BER supports the attack on MUN and BEL protects BER. England attacks DEN without German support. Italy and Austria coordinate against TRI; reassess after results.
Contest TRI with ADR, supported by VEN and Austria's VIE; TUS covers VEN. ION supports GRE as promised. BUL attacks CON; GAS to BUR, MAO to WES. Russia remains the urgent solo threat.

Support RUH–MUN with BER; NTH supports England’s SWE–DEN as promised. Italy/Austria coordinate against TRI. BEL advances to BUR; watch Russian pressure on BER and whether Germany/England keep commitments.

Italy attacks CON and TRI; Austria supports the attack on TRI. Defend both. Take NAP and press SWE/BER; move toward VIE via GAL. England’s quiet-line promise and Italy/Austria’s assurances are unreliable; France threatens MUN.

GRE holds with Italy's ION support; SMY supports Italy's attack on CON, breaking my assurance to Russia to keep SMY clear of it. VIE supports ADR–TRI as promised. Russia said BUD and TRI would hold; watch for frontier moves.

messages.body: Russia is at 14, and its A NAP can take NAP this fall. Please keep F TRI in TRI to reclaim that center, and have F ION support A GRE holding against Russia. I’ll defend VIE and GRE; keep your units clear of Austrian centers.

Russia is poised to reach 15 when NAP flips. Please keep pressing Russian-held MUN and protect BER; can you coordinate A RUH–MUN with support this fall? I’ll focus on defending VIE and GRE and preventing Russian gains in the south.
Are A BUD, A SER, or A CON moving against VIE or GRE this fall? I intend to defend my centers and am not attacking BUD or SER. Keep your units clear of Austrian centers, and tell me your plans.

F SWE will hold this Fall and will not attack NOR or any Russian center. Please keep F DEN and F SKA clear of SWE as you have kept the northern line quiet before; taking my last center would only open another front.

F SWE is my only center and will hold this Fall. Could A KIE support F SWE holding? Russia has F DEN and F SKA adjacent, so that support is the best way to deny it another center. I will keep clear of KIE.
Russia still has 14 centers and could threaten SWE from DEN and SKA. Please keep F NTH clear of my center and use your units to contain Russia in the west; what are your plans this Fall?
Russia’s A NAP is a direct threat to its next gains. Can you order F ION–NAP with F WES supporting? Please keep F TRI secure as well; Austria may be able to support its defense from VIE.
I’ll honor our agreement: F NTH will support your F SWE–DEN attack. Russia’s F SKA could support DEN, so please consider whether you can disrupt that support while still contesting the center.

Russia threatens both BER and KIE. I propose A BEL support A BER holding and A BER support A KIE holding; can you keep A KIE in place with A HOL supporting its hold? Let me know if you see a safer way to deny Russia.

Let’s take DEN from Russia this Fall: keep F SWE in place and order F SWE–DEN. I’ll have A KIE support the attack and A HOL support KIE holding. Please coordinate with France for additional support from F NTH.

Can F NTH support England’s F SWE–DEN this Fall? I’ll have A KIE support that attack and A HOL support KIE holding. If you can spare A RUH to support A BER–MUN as well, that keeps pressure on Russia; please keep your units clear of KIE and HOL.
Please recapture NAP this Fall: order A TUS–NAP with F ION supporting the attack. Russia’s F NAP is isolated, and taking it denies Russia a center while you regain one.

I’ll hold F TRI and move A TUS–NAP with F ION supporting, to reclaim NAP from Russia. Please have A GRE, A VIE, and F SMY prioritize defending GRE and VIE against A SER; Russia is close to a solo. Keep your units clear of TRI.

Russia still needs only four centers to win. Can you try A RUH–MUN with A BER supporting the move, and use your other units to pressure Russian-held centers rather than Italian ones? I’m holding F TRI and attacking A NAP.

I’m holding F TRI and will try to reclaim NAP from your A NAP. Are you planning to support A NAP this fall or attack any Italian-held centers? I won’t leave TRI undefended, and I expect you to keep clear of my other centers.

A NAP is already in Russian hands, and F TRI is the only obstacle to retaining TRI. Will F TRI leave TRI this Fall and will your other units stay clear of NAP? I’m prepared to avoid further Italian centers if you stop contesting the Russian line.

Russia needs centers this Fall. Will A GRE, A VIE, and F SMY refrain from supporting attacks on BUD, SER, or CON? If you keep my centers clear, I will focus my moves on securing the southern position rather than widening the frontier.

A MUN is exposed to A BER and A RUH. Will you keep both clear of MUN this Fall? I’ll keep my western units clear of French centers if you leave MUN alone; I need to secure the south, not open another front.

A GRE, A VIE, and F SMY will not attack or support attacks on BUD, SER, or CON. I’ll use them to defend my centers: A GRE supports VIE holding, A VIE holds, and F SMY supports GRE holding. Keep your forces clear of GRE and VIE.

I’ll defend as requested: A GRE supports VIE holding, A VIE holds, and F SMY supports GRE holding. My units will stay clear of TRI and won’t attack or support attacks on Russian centers. Your supported A TUS–NAP and F TRI hold are sensible; please keep your units clear of my centers.
I’ll order F SWE–DEN. Please keep your promise and have F NTH support F SWE–DEN; combined with German support, this should overcome any Russian support from SKA. Thanks for staying clear of SWE.

Agreed: I’ll order F SWE–DEN. Please have A KIE support F SWE–DEN and A HOL support A KIE holding, as you propose. France has confirmed F NTH will also support the attack, giving us the best chance to take DEN from Russia.

I’ll order A RUH–MUN with A BER supporting the attack, and A BEL supporting A BER’s hold. I’m also coordinating with England and Germany against Russian-held DEN. Please keep VIE and GRE secure and continue denying Russia gains in the south.

I can’t agree to leave MUN alone while you are so close to a solo. I intend to contest it with A RUH–MUN, supported by A BER. I have no intention of moving against French centers; please keep your western units clear of them.

F NTH will support your F SWE–DEN attack as agreed. Germany says A KIE will also support it. Russia’s F DEN and possible A PRU support make the attack contested, but this is our best chance to deny Russia a gain. I’ll press MUN with RUH and BER.

I’ll order A RUH–MUN with A BER supporting, and A BEL supporting BER’s defense. F NTH will support England’s attack on DEN, with Germany’s KIE also committed. I’ll keep my units clear of Italian centers; good luck dislodging A NAP and holding TRI.

F NTH will support England’s F SWE–DEN attack. I’ll order A RUH–MUN with A BER supporting the attack, while A BEL supports A BER holding. Please keep A KIE in place and have A HOL support its hold as planned; I’ll keep my units clear of KIE and HOL.
Yes. A KIE will support F SWE holding, and A HOL will support A KIE holding. Please keep F SWE in place; France may add support from F NTH. This is our best chance to deny Russia another center.

I’ll have A KIE support F SWE holding and A HOL support A KIE holding. Please order F NTH to support SWE holding, A BER to support KIE holding, and A BEL to support BER holding. If possible, have A RUH support BER holding too, against Russia’s armies in MUN, PRU, and SIL.

F TRI will hold to restore TRI to Italy. I can’t have F ION support A GRE: it will support A TUS–NAP, which is my best chance to reclaim NAP from Russia. A TUS and my other units will stay clear of Austrian centers.

F TRI will hold, and I will contest NAP with A TUS supported by F ION. I won’t attack other Italian-held centers, but I’m not agreeing to leave TRI or NAP uncontested. Keep your forces clear of VEN and my other centers.
I’ll reclaim NAP with A TUS–NAP, supported by F ION; I won’t also order F ION–NAP, since that would conflict with the army’s move. F WES can support A TUS–NAP, and F TRI will hold as requested.
Agreed: A TUS–NAP with F ION supporting. F TRI will hold to reclaim TRI as well. Russia’s southern gains must be denied.

A BUD will stay clear of VIE, and A SER will not attack GRE. A CON is focused on defending against Italy, not Austrian centers. Please keep A GRE, A VIE, and F SMY clear of BUD, SER, and CON this fall.
I’ll keep F DEN and F SKA clear of SWE this fall, as you ask. Please keep F SWE clear of NOR and my other northern centers; I’d prefer to maintain the quiet line while I deal with the southern front.

A NAP will hold against your attempt to reclaim it. I will not attack your other centers this fall, but I will contest your F TRI and will not accept Italy taking TRI. If you keep your forces clear of NAP, we can limit the fighting to those positions.

notes.note: Hold SWE as Germany's latest message requests; KIE supports hold and HOL supports KIE. France's NTH attack support for DEN conflicts with protecting my last center. Russia promised to keep DEN/SKA clear of SWE.

Support England's SWE–DEN with KIE; HOL supports KIE holding. This follows the DEN plan with England and France's NTH support, while guarding KIE. Italy plans to retake NAP and TRI; deny Russia any further gains.
Russia promised BUD clear of VIE and SER clear of GRE; hold all Austrian centers this Fall. Italy is trying to reclaim NAP and TRI. Monitor whether Russia kept its frontier promises.
Press MUN with RUH supported by BER; BEL holds BER. NTH supports England’s SWE-DEN attack as promised. Germany’s latest request to support KIE/SWE holds conflicts with the Russia containment plan.

Aim for TRI, BER, SWE while defending CON and MUN; hold NAP though Italy's supported attack may dislodge it. Break England's SWE agreement to grow. France promised RUH-MUN supported by BER; Austria says no attacks on Russian centers.

Hold TRI to return it to Italy; TUS→ROM with VEN support contests a Russian center. Russia's NAP is likely unrecoverable this turn without available support. BUL→CON, ION→AEG, GAS→BUR; WES→MAO. Austria promised not to aid Russia against TRI.

messages.body: Russia is at 15, so we need to deny it any gains. Can you commit A BER–MUN with A RUH supporting, and ask Germany to add A KIE support? Please keep BER defended and tell me your orders.

Please use your position to pressure Russian NAP or CON this turn, and keep F ADR and A VEN clear of TRI and my centers. Can you commit A ROM–NAP with support if available, and keep GRE, VIE, and SMY out of Russia’s reach?

Your forces still threaten my three centers, and you need only three more to win. Are A BUD, A TRI, A CON, or A BOH moving against VIE or GRE this turn? I will defend Austria; please keep them clear as you have promised.

Russia’s 15 centers make BER decisive. Please order A KIE to support A BER holding while A HOL supports A KIE holding. I’ll have A BEL support BER and A BER support A RUH–MUN, so we can pressure MUN without leaving BER undefended.

Please attack Russian NAP with A ROM–NAP, supported by F AEG. Can F ADR instead support Austria’s A VIE–TRI attack? That pressures two Russian centers at once; keep your other units clear of French centers.
Please coordinate with Italy to attack Russian TRI: order A VIE–TRI, with Italy’s F ADR supporting. Keep A GRE and F SMY covering your centers; every Russian center we deny matters with Russia at 15.

Russia is at 15, so we must prevent any gains this turn. Please tell me your plan for BER, RUH, and BEL. Can BER support my A KIE holding while BEL protects BER? I’ll use HOL to support KIE; please also pressure Russian MUN or PRU if you can.

Russia is one turn from a solo. What are your plans for NAP, CON, and TRI? Please focus your units on denying Russia a center—especially attack NAP or CON if viable—and coordinate with Austria. I’ll defend KIE and HOL.

Russia is at 15 and must be stopped immediately. What are your plans for TRI and CON? Please coordinate with Italy to attack a Russian center this turn, and avoid opening a front against Germany. I’ll hold KIE with HOL support.

Russia is at 15; we need to deny it centers this turn. I plan F ADR–TRI, F BUL/SOUTH–CON, and A ROM–NAP with F AEG supporting. Can A VIE support my attack on TRI while A GRE and F SMY defend your centers? Please avoid any support for Russia.

Russia is three centers from a solo. Please attack MUN with A RUH, supported by A BER, and coordinate with Germany if possible. I’m attacking TRI and CON and making a supported attempt on NAP; keep your units clear of Italian centers.

Russia is at 15, so please attack its centers rather than spend this turn only defending. Can A KIE–MUN with A HOL supporting, and coordinate with France for extra support? I’m attacking TRI, CON, and NAP in the south.

The current position has A CON, A TRI, and A NAP in Russian hands, with your F ADR and F BUL/SOUTH nearby. Are you attacking any of those centers this spring, and with what support? If you keep them clear, I can avoid Italian centers this turn; otherwise I must defend and widen the fight.

Will A RUH move to MUN, and will A BER support it this spring? If you leave MUN unchallenged, I can keep A BER and A PRU out of French centers. I need to know your exact orders before deciding whether to reinforce the western front.

What are A VIE, A GRE, and F SMY doing this spring? Russia needs centers urgently, but I would rather avoid widening our frontier. Please confirm whether you will keep those units clear of BUD, SER, and CON, and whether you intend to defend VIE or GRE.

I’m coordinating with Italy’s F ADR–TRI: A VIE will support the attack, while A GRE supports VIE holding and F SMY supports GRE holding. I won’t move against German centers. Please keep pressing Russian MUN and protect KIE and HOL.

A VIE will support Italy’s F ADR–TRI; A GRE will support VIE holding, and F SMY will support GRE holding. I’ll keep A GRE, A VIE, and F SMY clear of BUD, SER, and CON, and will defend VIE and GRE. Please keep A BUD and A BOH clear of VIE.

Yes: A VIE will support F ADR–TRI. A GRE will support VIE holding, and F SMY will support GRE holding. Please keep your forces clear of VIE, GRE, and SMY, and press Russian NAP or CON with your other units.

I’ll coordinate with Italy: A VIE will support F ADR–TRI, with A GRE supporting VIE holding and F SMY supporting GRE holding. Please continue pressing Russian MUN and coordinate with Germany to keep pressure on Russia’s western centers.

I’ll keep A BER in place supporting A KIE’s hold, with A BEL supporting BER; please keep A KIE holding and A HOL supporting it. A BUR will support A RUH–MUN. BER can’t support both KIE and the attack, so this protects the line while still pressuring MUN.

I’ll keep A BER holding, supported by A BEL, and order A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting the attack. I can’t send BER to MUN without leaving it exposed. Please proceed with A VIE–TRI supported by Italy’s F ADR, while GRE and SMY remain covered.

I will order A RUH–MUN, with A BUR supporting the attack. I won’t leave BER undefended, and I have no intention of moving against French centers. At 15 centers, you cannot expect me to leave your western front unchallenged.

I’ll order A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting, while A BER holds and supports Germany’s A KIE; A BEL supports BER. Please coordinate F ADR’s support for Austria’s A VIE–TRI as proposed. Your A ROM–NAP with F AEG support is your move; my units will stay clear of Italian centers.

I can’t make KIE–MUN a supported attack: HOL cannot support a move to MUN, and moving KIE would expose it. I’ll defend instead, with KIE supporting BER’s hold and HOL supporting KIE. Your attacks on TRI, CON, and NAP are vital—please coordinate with Austria where useful.

Agreed: I’ll order KIE to support BER holding and HOL to support KIE holding. Your BEL support keeps BER protected while BER supports RUH–MUN. Please keep BER secured; denying Russia another center is essential.
I’m attacking NAP with A ROM supported by F AEG, and F BUL/SOUTH will attack CON. Please order A KIE–MUN with A HOL supporting, and coordinate with France; every Russian center denied matters.
I’ll have F ADR support A VIE–TRI, as France suggested, while A ROM attacks NAP with F AEG supporting and F BUL/SOUTH attacks CON. Please keep GRE and SMY defended, and avoid supporting Russia.

I’m attacking NAP with A ROM supported by F AEG, attacking CON with F BUL/SOUTH, and supporting A VIE–TRI with F ADR. I won’t leave your southern centers uncontested; please keep clear of Italian centers.

Agreed: F ADR will support Austria’s A VIE–TRI attack. I’m also sending A ROM–NAP with F AEG supporting and F BUL/SOUTH–CON. Please keep pressing Russian centers and keep your units clear of Italian centers.

A BUD will hold, and A CON is focused on the Italian front. A TRI and A BOH will not attack VIE or GRE this spring; I can’t promise that restraint beyond this turn. Are A GRE and A VIE mutually supporting, and will F SMY stay clear of CON?

notes.note: Hold GRE; support Italy’s F BUL/SOUTH–CON from SMY and F ADR–TRI from VIE to deny Russia centers. Italy promised to keep units clear of Austrian centers; Russia promised BUD/BOH clear of VIE this spring.
Hold KIE with HOL support to deny Russia a German center; France says BER supports KIE and BEL protects BER while BUR supports RUH–MUN. Italy is attacking NAP, CON, and TRI.

Press MUN: RUH moves with BUR support. BER supports KIE holding; BEL holds. NTH attacks DEN; PIC to BRE and WAL to LVP. Germany pledged KIE hold with HOL support. Italy/Austria coordinate against Russian NAP/TRI/CON; watch Russia’s 15-center solo threat.

Press Russia: ADR→TRI with VIE's promised support and VEN supporting; ROM→NAP supported by AEG; BUL→CON. GAS→SPA, MAO→WES. France promised pressure on MUN and to stay clear of Italian centers; Austria promised support for TRI and no aid to Russia.

At 15 centers, pursue supported CON-BUL and PRU-BER; protect TRI and MUN. NAP evacuates Italy’s supported attack, likely conceding it temporarily. Italy and Austria remain hostile; France is attacking MUN.

messages.body: Russia is at 15, so we must deny it every center this Fall. Please keep F TRI in TRI and use your remaining units to contest NAP or CON. I will keep A VIE, A GRE, and F SMY defending Austria; keep your units clear of VIE, GRE, and SMY.

You need three centers to win, and I must defend Austria. Are A BUD, A SER, A BOH, or A TYR moving against VIE or GRE this Fall? Please keep them clear of Austrian centers; I will keep A VIE, A GRE, and F SMY out of BUD, SER, and CON.

Russia is at 15. Please keep your forces in BER, DEN, and MUN so those centers remain out of Russian hands this Fall, and continue pressing Russian-held centers where safe. I will defend VIE and GRE and coordinate with Italy to deny Russia gains in the south.

This is our best chance to deny Russia BER. Please order A KIE to support my A MUN–BER, with A HOL supporting A KIE holding. I’ll support the attack from A BUR; A BEL can add support if needed. Can you commit to KIE supporting MUN–BER?
Russia must not take NAP or TRI this Fall. Please hold A NAP with F AEG supporting it, and keep F TRI in place. Can you also coordinate with Austria for support to TRI from VIE?
Please support Italy’s F TRI holding from A VIE this Fall if Italy keeps F TRI in place. Russia is at 15; denying it TRI is critical. Keep GRE and SMY covered as you can.

Please keep F DEN and A MUN in place to take those centers, and order A MUN–BER with A BEL supporting. I’ll have A KIE support the attack and A HOL support A KIE holding. This is our best chance to deny Russia BER while protecting KIE.
Please keep A NAP and F TRI in place this Fall to reclaim those Russian centers. They’re vital to stopping Russia’s solo; I’ll keep my units out of Italian centers.
This Fall’s center changes can stop your solo: France can reclaim DEN and MUN, and Italy NAP and TRI. Please keep A BER clear of KIE and don’t attack my last centers; I’ll focus on defending Germany.

Russia must lose centers this Fall. Please keep F DEN and A MUN in place so DEN and MUN transfer to you. If it’s safe, can A MUN attack BER with A BEL and A BUR supporting? I’m holding NAP and TRI to deny Russia those gains.

Please have A VIE support F TRI holding this Fall; Russia can’t be allowed to retake TRI. Keep GRE and SMY defended, and avoid supporting any Russian attack on Italian units or centers. I’m holding NAP and TRI and need every Russian center denied.

Are you planning to attack NAP or TRI this Fall? I’m holding both to deny you centers. Keep your units clear of Italian centers; I will continue contesting your southern line rather than accept your expansion.

What are F DEN and A MUN doing this Fall? If you leave both centers unoccupied, I can keep my western units out of BEL and PAR this turn. Please give me your exact plans; otherwise I must contest them.
Are A NAP and F TRI holding this Fall, or will they withdraw? If you clear both Russian centers, I can keep my units out of your centers this turn. Please state your exact orders.
Will A GRE, F SMY, or A VIE attack or support attacks on BUD, SER, or CON this Fall? If you keep my centers clear, I can avoid VIE and GRE and focus on the Italian front.

A VIE, A GRE, and F SMY will not attack or support attacks on BUD, SER, or CON. I plan A VIE to support F TRI holding, A GRE to support VIE holding, and F SMY to support GRE holding. Please keep A BUD, A SER, A BOH, and A TYR clear of VIE and GRE.
Yes. A VIE will support F TRI holding this Fall; A GRE will support VIE holding, and F SMY will support GRE holding. Please keep F TRI in place and your units clear of VIE, GRE, and SMY.
Yes: A VIE will support Italy’s F TRI holding this Fall, while A GRE supports VIE holding and F SMY supports GRE holding. Please keep your forces in BER, DEN, and MUN to deny Russia those centers.

I’ll keep F DEN and A MUN in place so DEN and MUN transfer to France. I can’t hold BER with my current units; I won’t vacate MUN to make an unsupported attack. Please have VIE support Italy’s F TRI holding, and keep GRE and SMY covered.
F DEN and A MUN will remain in place this Fall. I’m not moving into your centers from the west, but I won’t leave French-held positions exposed or promise to stop contesting your expansion.
I’ll keep F DEN and A MUN in place so DEN and MUN transfer to France. Please hold F TRI and A NAP to deny you-know-who those centers; I’ve asked Austria to support TRI from VIE if possible.

I can’t order A MUN–BER while keeping MUN occupied, and neither BUR nor BEL can support an attack into BER. I’ll keep A MUN in place to secure the center for France. Please use KIE and HOL to protect your own position; Russia must lose ground in the south.
Confirmed: A KIE supports A MUN–BER, and A HOL supports A KIE holding. Please have A BUR and A BEL support MUN–BER if possible; reclaiming BER and denying Russia its next center is our priority.

A NAP will hold, supported by F AEG; F BUL/SOUTH will attack CON. F TRI will hold, with A VEN supporting its defense. Please have A VIE support F TRI holding as you offered earlier; keep A GRE and F SMY defending your centers.
A NAP and F TRI are holding this Fall; I will not withdraw them. I will continue contesting your southern line rather than leave those centers to you.
A NAP and F TRI will hold this Fall, denying Russia those centers. F AEG supports NAP, and I’m continuing to contest CON with F BUL/SOUTH. Please keep KIE and HOL secure.

A NAP will hold with F AEG supporting, and F TRI will hold with A VEN supporting. I’ve asked Austria for A VIE support to TRI as well. Please keep F DEN and A MUN in place to take those centers from Russia.

A BUD and A SER will stay clear of VIE and GRE this Fall, and I am not committing A BOH or A TYR against them this turn. I need to secure my western position and contain Italy. Please keep A VIE, A GRE, and F SMY from supporting attacks on BUD or CON.

I will contest your occupation of NAP and TRI: A APU can move against NAP, and A TYR can pressure TRI. I cannot promise to keep clear of Italian centers while you hold Russian centers and continue contesting my southern line. Please do not support attacks on CON.

A BER will stay clear of KIE, and I have no order planned against A KIE or A HOL this Fall. I’m focused on securing my western position. Please do not support France’s pressure against BER or MUN, and keep your units clear of Russian centers.

notes.note: Hold GRE and SMY; VIE supports Italy’s F TRI holding to deny Russia a center. Russia promised to keep its units clear of VIE/GRE; Italy promised to keep units clear of Austrian centers and hold TRI.

Hold NAP with AEG support and TRI with VEN support; Austria promised VIE support to TRI. BUL attacks CON to contest Russia. France promised to keep DEN and MUN for France. Russia threatened NAP/TRI; deny its gains.
Russia promises to leave KIE/HOL alone; still support KIE’s hold against nearby pressure. France reversed its MUN–BER plan and will hold MUN instead. Italy says NAP and TRI will hold to deny Russia.

Attack Russian BER from MUN with Germany’s promised KIE support; BUR replaces MUN, DEN stays to transfer to France. BEL advances to RUH, BRE to GAS, LVP to CLY. Italy says NAP/TRI held; Austria promised TRI support. Russia threatened to contest if we don’t vacate.
Attack ROM, TRI, MUN and DEN; hold CON and keep BER for the capture. France says DEN/MUN stay put; Italy says NAP/TRI hold and remains hostile. Austria promised not to attack BUD/SER/CON.

messages.body: Russia is at 15, and A TYR is an immediate threat to VIE. Are A TYR, A BUD, and A BOH moving against my centers this spring? I will defend Austria; please keep them clear of VIE and GRE as you have before.

A TYR threatens VIE. Please keep A VEN clear of Austrian centers and, if you can, have A VEN support VIE holding while A VIE supports F TRI holding. Can you also keep pressing Russia at CON or another front?
Russia is at 15. Please renew pressure on MUN: A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting, if possible. Keeping Russia from gaining in the west is essential; let me know whether you can commit to that attack.

Russia is at 15; we need to deny it another gain. Please order A KIE to support my A BUR–MUN, with A HOL supporting KIE holding. I’ll keep A RUH in place and order it to support BUR–MUN. Can you commit to that support?

Please attack Russian ROM this turn: A NAP–ROM, with F TYS and A VEN supporting the attack. That gives us a strong chance to take a Russian center and deny its solo. Keep your other units covering your centers.

Russia is at 15, so we need to pressure its southern centers and avoid any further gains. Can F SMY attack CON with A GRE supporting, while A VIE stays ready to defend? Please coordinate with Italy on the southern front and tell me your plan.

Russia is at 15. Can you order A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting? I’ll have A KIE support the attack and A HOL support KIE holding. This gives us a real chance to take a Russian center while protecting my last two.

Please attack CON with F BUL/SOUTH, supported by F AEG, and coordinate with Austria for F SMY support. Keep F TRI safe from Russian pressure—can A VEN support TRI holding? Russia is at 15, so every center denied matters.

Please support Italy’s F BUL/SOUTH–CON with F SMY, while A VIE supports TRI holding and A GRE holds. This coordinates pressure on Russia without exposing your centers; Russia is at 15 and must be stopped.

Russia is still at 15, so we must deny it any gain. I plan F BUL/SOUTH–CON, with F AEG supporting. Can A GRE support that attack, and can A VIE support F TRI holding against a possible attack from BUD? Please keep GRE and SMY defended and avoid supporting Russia.

Russia is at 15 and still threatens a solo. Please coordinate with Germany to pressure MUN: A BUR–MUN with A RUH supporting would force Russia to defend. Keep your units clear of Italian centers, and tell me if Russia is threatening you elsewhere.

Russia must not gain another center. Please coordinate with France on pressure against MUN, and keep HOL and KIE secure. Can A KIE support A HOL holding if threatened? I’m attacking CON from BUL/SOUTH with AEG support; please tell France to keep pressure on Russia rather than Italian centers.

Russia needs centers urgently. Are A VIE, A GRE, and F SMY defending or moving this spring, and will any support attacks on CON? I am considering moves against Austrian centers; if you keep clear of CON and my southern units, tell me what accommodation you can offer.

Will F BUL/SOUTH or any other Italian unit attack CON this spring, and are you moving against ROM or another Russian center? I can focus elsewhere if you stop contesting CON and leave my centers alone; please give your exact plans.

Are A BUR, A RUH, or F NTH moving against MUN or DEN this spring? I need to know whether you intend to keep pressing my western line. If you leave my centers unchallenged, I can keep my units clear of French centers this turn.

Austria’s priority is defending VIE and GRE; I’m not offering support for attacks on CON or your southern units. Please keep A TYR, A BUD, and A BOH clear of my centers this spring. Any move against VIE or GRE will meet resistance.

I can have A GRE support F BUL/SOUTH–CON, while F SMY supports GRE holding and A VIE supports F TRI holding. Please have A VEN support VIE holding against A TYR, and keep your other forces clear of Austrian centers.

I can’t send F SMY–CON: it needs to support A GRE holding while GRE supports Italy’s F BUL/SOUTH–CON. A VIE will support F TRI holding. Please keep pressure on Russia’s western centers and deny it any gains there.

I can’t use F SMY to support Italy’s CON attack; it needs to support A GRE holding. A GRE can support F BUL/SOUTH–CON, while A VIE supports TRI. Please keep pressing Russia in the west and help deny it further centers.
A RUH will move to MUN, supported by A BUR; Germany says A KIE will also support the attack. F NTH is not moving against DEN this spring. Your western line remains our concern while you are at 15.

Confirmed: A RUH–MUN, with A BUR supporting. Germany has offered A KIE support for the attack. Please keep denying Russia gains in the south and coordinate with Italy on protecting TRI and the Balkan centers.

I’m pressing Russian MUN with A RUH–MUN, supported by A BUR and Germany’s A KIE. No French unit is threatening Italian centers. Please proceed with A NAP–ROM supported by F TYS and A VEN, as proposed.
Confirmed: I’ll order A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting. Please commit A KIE to support the attack and A HOL to support A KIE holding. This is our best immediate chance to deny Russia another center.

I’ll keep A HOL and A KIE focused on stopping Russia. A KIE cannot both support A HOL holding and support France’s attack on MUN; I’m committing it to BUR–MUN, with A HOL supporting KIE’s hold. I’ll urge France to keep pressure on Russia. Your CON attack is vital.

I’ll have A KIE support A BUR–MUN and A HOL support A KIE holding. With A RUH supporting as you propose, that gives the attack strength three. Please keep pressure on Russian centers and avoid German centers; Russia’s next gain could end the game.
Yes. F BUL/SOUTH will move to CON with F AEG supporting. A NAP will attack ROM; I’m not withdrawing from your southern centers. Keep your units clear of Italian centers.

A VEN can’t support VIE while it supports A NAP–ROM; France and I are coordinating that attack. Please have A GRE support VIE holding, and A VIE support F TRI holding as you proposed. F BUL/SOUTH–CON with F AEG support remains my plan.
Agreed: A NAP–ROM, with F TYS and A VEN supporting. I’m also attacking CON with F BUL/SOUTH and F AEG support. Please keep pressing Russia in the north and stay clear of Italian centers.

F BUL/SOUTH–CON with F AEG support is planned. A VEN is committed to supporting A NAP–ROM at France’s request, so I can’t support TRI from VEN. Austria can support F TRI from VIE; please keep KIE and HOL secure and press Russia where possible.

A BUD will hold, and I have no A BOH. A TYR is oriented toward the Italian front; I’m not promising to leave VIE or GRE unpressured beyond this turn. Keep F SMY and A GRE clear of CON, and we can avoid widening the southern conflict.

notes.note: Support France’s RUH–MUN attack with KIE; HOL supports KIE holding. France confirmed BUR supports the attack. Italy and Austria are pressing CON; Russia is at 15, so denying its next center remains urgent.

Press MUN with RUH supported by BUR; Germany promised KIE support. NTH probes NOR. Italy agreed to attack ROM and CON; Austria is coordinating against Russia. Keep clear of Italian and German centers.

Attack CON with AEG support and ROM with TYS/VEN support; hold TRI, backed by Austria's promised VIE support. Austria promised GRE support to CON. France and Germany are pressing MUN and promised to stay clear of Italian centers. SPA moves to cover MAR.

Spring 1915: press SMY, VIE, and BUL for three possible centers; defend CON with BLA and MUN with SIL, while BER cuts KIE's support. Italy announced BUL/S->CON supported by AEG and NAP->ROM; Austria says it will defend.

Support Italy’s BUL/SOUTH–CON with GRE and SMY; VIE supports TRI holding as promised. Russia’s TYR may threaten VIE, but a lone attack should bounce. Keep Austrian centers covered and deny Russia gains.

messages.body: Your units now hold VIE, and I will not contest BUD or SER this turn. Are A GRE or F SMY threatened? Keep them clear of my remaining centers; an attack on GRE or SMY will make further Austrian accommodation impossible.

Please keep A ROM in ROM this Fall so Russia loses that center, and keep your forces clear of GRE and SMY. If Russia threatens GRE, can F AEG support A GRE holding? I will defend my remaining centers.

Please keep F NOR in NOR this Fall so Russia loses that center; holding it is critical to preventing a Russian solo. Italy can keep A ROM in ROM as well. Let me know if Russia has threatened your position.

Russia is still at 15. Please order A KIE to support my A RUH–MUN, with A BUR also supporting, and A HOL to support KIE holding. If we take MUN while F NOR and A ROM stay put, we can sharply reduce the solo threat.
Please support my A RUH–MUN with A BOH this Fall; A BUR will also support, and I’m asking Germany for A KIE support. Keep A GRE and F SMY safe as you can. Russia must not reach 18.

Please keep A ROM holding this Fall so ROM transfers to you, and keep F TRI secure. I’m coordinating a supported A RUH–MUN attack with Germany and Austria; Russia must lose centers rather than gain them.

Russia is at 15. Please keep F NOR there to reclaim NOR and attack A MUN from RUH; I can support RUH–MUN from KIE while HOL supports KIE holding. Can BUR support the attack, and will you avoid German centers?

Russia’s A VIE could give it the solo. Please attack VIE from BOH this Fall and coordinate with Italy for support from VEN if possible. What are your orders for GRE and SMY? Germany will keep its units focused on stopping Russia in the west.
Russia’s A VIE could give it the solo. Can A VEN support Austria’s A BOH–VIE this Fall? Please also keep A ROM in place to reclaim ROM, and tell me your plan for protecting your centers.
Russia taking VIE would be a serious setback. Can you order A BOH–VIE with A GRE supporting? I’ll keep A ROM in ROM, supported by F TYS, to secure that center for Italy and deny Russia the gain.

Please keep F NOR in NOR to take it from Russia, and continue pressing A MUN with A RUH supported where possible. I’ll hold A ROM with F TYS support; can you confirm your Fall orders and avoid Italian centers?

Russia must be denied any gains this Fall. Can A HOL and A KIE support France’s pressure on A MUN or otherwise contest Russian centers? Please keep both units clear of Italian centers; I’m holding ROM and supporting it from TYS.
F NOR is occupying a Russian center. Will you withdraw it this Fall and keep A BUR/A RUH out of MUN? I can keep my western units clear of French centers if you leave NOR and MUN uncontested.
Will A KIE support France’s attack on A MUN this Fall? Please keep A KIE and A HOL out of the attack; I’ll keep my units clear of your centers if you do.
A ROM is occupying a Russian center. Will you move it out this Fall? I can keep A APU clear of Italian centers if you stop contesting ROM and leave my southern line alone.

I can’t support RUH–MUN from BOH: my army there must attack Russian A VIE, with A GRE supporting, to reclaim Vienna and deny Russia a center. Please proceed with your attack and seek Germany’s support.
I’ll order A BOH–VIE with A GRE supporting, as you suggest. I’ve asked Italy to have A VEN support the attack; A SMY will support A GRE holding. Please keep pressing Russia in the west.
Agreed: A BOH–VIE with A GRE supporting. Please add A VEN support to the attack if you can; that may be decisive against Russian support from BUD. I’ll keep F SMY supporting A GRE holding.
I’ll order A RUH–MUN, with A BUR supporting, and would welcome A BOH support as well. F NOR will hold to reclaim the center from Russia. Please keep A GRE and F SMY safe.
I’ll order A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting; please have A KIE support the attack and A HOL support KIE holding. I’ll avoid German centers. F NOR will hold to reclaim it from Russia.
F NOR will hold to reclaim the center from Russia, and A RUH will attack MUN with A BUR supporting. Please keep A ROM in place with F TYS supporting its hold, and keep F TRI secure.

I won’t withdraw F NOR or leave MUN uncontested. F NOR will hold, and A RUH will attack MUN with A BUR supporting. Your threat to contest French centers doesn’t change the need to stop your expansion.
Confirmed: A KIE supports A RUH–MUN, and A HOL supports A KIE holding. Please have A BUR support RUH–MUN and keep F NOR in place to reclaim NOR. I’ll keep both German units clear of French centers.
I’ll keep A HOL and A KIE clear of Italian centers. I’m supporting France’s attack on MUN from KIE; please keep A ROM in place to reclaim ROM and coordinate against Russia’s gains.
I will support France’s attack on MUN from KIE. Your assurance to leave my centers alone doesn’t outweigh the chance to deny you another center; A HOL will support A KIE holding.

A ROM will hold with F TYS supporting, as promised. I can order F AEG to support A GRE holding if you want, though I see no immediate Russian attack on GRE. I’ll keep my forces clear of GRE and SMY; please press A BOH–VIE with A GRE supporting.

Confirmed: A ROM holds with F TYS support, and I’ll keep F TRI secure. Please keep F NOR in place and continue pressuring MUN; keep your units clear of Italian centers. Austria is trying to contest Russia’s A VIE.

I’ll hold A ROM with F TYS supporting. A KIE can support A RUH–MUN if France attacks; A HOL cannot support that move, so keep it holding or supporting KIE. Please keep both units clear of Italian centers and contest Russia wherever possible.
I won’t move A ROM out: it holds with F TYS supporting, and I’m not conceding your southern line while you remain at 15. Keep A APU clear of Italian centers; I’ll continue denying you ROM.

A GRE and F SMY are not my targets this turn; I’m not attacking either center. A VIE will hold, and I ask that A GRE and A BOH leave it unchallenged. I’ll keep my units clear of GRE and SMY this turn.

notes.note: Support France’s RUH–MUN attack from KIE; HOL supports KIE holding. France says BUR supports and NOR stays; Italy holds ROM. Russia promised to avoid German centers, but watch KIE/HOL.

Keep ROM for Italy; TYS supports its hold. AEG supports BUL–CON to contest Russia. Hold TRI with VEN support against possible A VIE attack. MAR moves to GAS. France promised to hold NOR and press MUN; Austria promised BOH–VIE with GRE support.

Keep F NOR to take the center; press MUN with RUH, BUR, and Germany’s promised KIE support. Germany promised HOL support for KIE; Austria cannot support, as BOH attacks VIE. Italy promised ROM hold and secure TRI.

Attack Russian VIE from BOH; Italy said VEN may support. GRE takes vacant SER for Austria. SMY supports Italy's AEG–CON if ordered. France holds NOR and Italy holds ROM to deny Russia gains; Russia promised to leave GRE/SMY clear.

Try to gain NAP, BUL, VIE and retake NOR; expect Italy to reclaim ROM. FIN+SKA attack NOR; ARM convoy via BLA with CON/RUM support attacks BUL. BER-KIE cuts German support against MUN; SIL supports MUN, BUD supports VIE.

messages.body: Please support my A BOH–VIE with A VEN this spring. Russia still holds VIE, and retaking it denies Russia a center while restoring Austria’s position. What are your plans for A VEN and the rest of your units?
Please renew the attack on Russian MUN: A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting. Can you commit to that this spring, and are you coordinating German support? Russia must not gain another center.

Can A KIE support France’s A RUH–MUN this spring? France can attack from RUH with A BUR supporting; coordinated support could dislodge Russia from MUN and deny it a center. Please keep HOL and KIE safe if possible.
Russia is still at 14, so we need to take centers, not just hold. Please have A KIE support my A RUH–MUN again, and keep A HOL supporting KIE. I’ll order RUH–MUN; can you confirm KIE’s support?

Please have A BOH support my A RUH–MUN this turn if you can; that’s our clearest western chance to take a Russian center. Keep VIE and your remaining centers covered, and coordinate with Italy to deny Russia any southern gains.

Can you attack Russian A NAP with A ROM–NAP, supported by F TYS? Russia is still at 14, and every center matters. Please also keep TRI and your other centers secure and coordinate with Austria against Russian gains in the south.
Russia still has 14 centers. Can you order A BOH–VIE with A SER supporting the attack, and keep F SMY safe? I’m coordinating pressure on MUN in the west; please tell me whether you can commit to VIE.

Let’s renew the attack on Russian MUN: please order A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting, and keep your units clear of HOL and KIE. I’ll order A KIE to support RUH–MUN and A HOL to support KIE holding. Can you commit?

Please help deny Russia another center: can A VEN support Austria’s A BOH–VIE, and can A ROM–NAP with F TYS supporting to retake NAP? Let me know what you can commit to; I’m coordinating a western attack on MUN.
Russia’s A VIE and A BUD threaten your last centers. I’m considering A ROM–NAP with F TYS and F AEG supporting. What are your orders? Can we coordinate pressure on VIE while keeping SER secure?

Russia can still win at 14, so we need to deny it gains everywhere. I’m considering A ROM–NAP with F TYS and F AEG supporting. Are you attacking MUN, and how will you defend your northern centers against BER/PRU/NOR?

Russia is still at 14. Can A KIE support France’s A RUH–MUN this turn, and what are you doing to defend HOL and KIE? I’m considering A ROM–NAP with F TYS and F AEG supporting; I’ll keep my units clear of your centers.

What are A SER, A BOH, and F SMY doing this turn? I’m considering pressure on SER and need to know whether you’ll defend it or support attacks elsewhere. If you keep your units clear of BUD and CON, I can focus my southern forces on Italy.

What are A RUH and A BUR doing against MUN this turn, and will F STP/NORTH threaten NOR? I need to secure Russian centers. If you leave MUN and NOR alone this turn, I’ll keep BER and PRU clear of French centers.

What are F CON, F TRI, and A ROM doing this turn? Your forces remain on Russian centers, so I have to defend and press back. If you withdraw from CON and stop contesting my southern line, I can keep my units clear of your centers this turn.

I can’t support RUH–MUN from BOH while Russia holds VIE on my frontier. I’m renewing the attack on VIE from BOH with SER support; please coordinate with Germany for KIE support on your MUN attack. We need to deny Russia gains on both fronts.
I’ll order A BOH–VIE with A SER supporting. Please seek A KIE support for France’s RUH–MUN; that lets us pressure Russia on both fronts. F SMY will stay safe.

A SER will remain focused on defending Serbia, and F SMY will stay in place. I’m not planning moves against BUD or CON. I need to protect my remaining centers, so I can’t offer you further accommodation.

I plan A BOH–VIE with A SER supporting. Can A VEN support that attack? Your A ROM–NAP with F TYS and F AEG support sounds useful; please keep A VEN available for VIE and your forces clear of SER and GRE.

Yes: A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting. Germany has confirmed A KIE support for the attack and A HOL supporting KIE. Please keep your remaining centers covered and coordinate with Italy against Russian gains in the south.
Confirmed: A RUH–MUN, A BUR supporting, and A KIE supporting the attack; A HOL supports KIE holding. I’ll keep my units clear of HOL and KIE. Let’s take MUN and deny Russia another center.

A RUH will attack MUN with A BUR supporting; Germany has confirmed KIE support. My fleet at STP will stay there to defend the center this turn, not threaten NOR. I have no move planned against BER or PRU.

Yes: A RUH–MUN with A BUR and Germany’s A KIE supporting. I’ll keep BEL and STP defended; the Russian units in BER/PRU have no direct move into BEL. One map note: F AEG cannot support an attack on NAP from AEG, though F TYS can support A ROM–NAP.
Confirmed: A KIE supports your A RUH–MUN, and A HOL supports A KIE holding. I’ll keep both units clear of French centers. Russia may reinforce MUN, but this is our best chance to dislodge it.

Yes: A KIE will support France’s A RUH–MUN, and A HOL will support A KIE holding, keeping my centers covered. I can’t assist your attack on VIE directly; A BOH–VIE with A SER supporting is your best available pressure there.

A KIE will support France’s A RUH–MUN, while A HOL supports A KIE holding. That is how I’m protecting both German centers. Your A ROM–NAP attack with fleet support sounds useful; please keep your units clear of HOL and KIE.

I’ll order A ROM–NAP with F TYS supporting, and keep F TRI protected with A VEN supporting its hold. F CON will hold. Please continue your pressure on MUN and guard your northern centers against BER, PRU, and NOR; Russia must not gain another center.

A VEN cannot support BOH–VIE: Venice is not adjacent to Vienna. I’ll use A VEN to support F TRI holding, and A ROM–NAP with F TYS supporting; F CON holds. Please have A SER support BOH–VIE if possible, and keep GRE secure.

A ROM–NAP with F TYS support is committed. A VEN cannot support BOH–VIE from Venice, so I’ll use it to support F TRI holding. F CON holds. I’ll keep my units clear of your centers; please coordinate with France on MUN and defend HOL and KIE.

F CON will hold, F TRI will hold with A VEN supporting, and A ROM will attack NAP with F TYS supporting. I’m not withdrawing from your southern line while you remain at 14 centers; keep your units clear of Italian centers.

notes.note: HOL supports KIE holding against possible Russian pressure from MUN; KIE supports France’s RUH–MUN as promised. France and Austria confirmed their coordinated attacks; Italy committed ROM–NAP and will keep clear of German centers.

BOH supports France RUH–MUN as agreed with France/Germany; SER holds to protect Austria’s center. SMY supports Italy’s CON hold against Russian pressure. Italy said ROM attacks NAP; Russia threatens Italy’s south.
Attack Russian NAP with ROM, supported by TYS. Protect CON with AEG and TRI with VEN as promised; keep F TRI secure. MAR to PIE for future positioning. France/Germany press MUN; Austria contests VIE.

Spring 1916: RUH attacks MUN with BUR and Germany’s promised KIE support; Germany also promised HOL supports KIE. PAR moves to GAS with BRE support. Austria cannot support MUN; Italy promised ROM–NAP and TRI protection. Keep clear of German and Italian centers.

France and Germany coordinate RUH-MUN; PRU convoy to KIE cuts KIE support, while BER/SIL protect MUN. Italy remains hostile at NAP/CON/TRI: strike CON and SER, evade NAP attack. Austria says SER defends; no reliable accommodation.

messages.body: Please renew A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting, and secure the promised A KIE support from Germany. Russia must not gain another center; let me know if you expect the attack to succeed.
Please keep your promised A KIE support for France’s A RUH–MUN, with A HOL supporting A KIE holding. This is our best chance to deny Russia a center this Fall; confirm you’re still committed.

Please keep A NAP in NAP this Fall so Italy regains that center, and keep your units clear of GRE and SMY. Can A VEN and A PIE pressure Russia’s A VIE, while you tell me whether Russia is threatening your southern centers?

I’ll renew A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting. Please confirm A KIE will support the attack. A HOL cannot support KIE holding if KIE leaves to support the attack, so consider the risk to KIE from PRU and choose its orders accordingly. I’ll stay clear of HOL and KIE.

Please keep A NAP in place so Napoli transfers to you, and protect your other centers. Russia’s occupation of SER and STP may give it two centers this Fall; can you coordinate with Austria to deny further Russian gains?

Russia’s units occupy SER and STP, so it may gain both this Fall. What are your orders to contest Russia and protect GRE and SMY? I’m renewing A RUH–MUN with A BUR support, and will stay clear of German centers.

Please confirm A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting; I’ll have A KIE support it and A HOL support KIE holding. Russia’s A STP also threatens to take STP this Fall—can you make any move that would deny that gain?
Please hold A NAP with F TYS supporting so Italy retakes NAP. Can A VEN support Austria’s A BOH–VIE? Russia is poised to gain SER and STP, so every Russian center we can deny matters.
What are your Fall orders for BOH, GRE, and SMY? Russia’s A SER threatens to take SER; can you coordinate with Italy’s A VEN to attack VIE from BOH while keeping your remaining centers safe?
Russia’s A SER must not be allowed to take SER. Please order A BOH–SER with A GRE supporting; I’ll keep my forces clear of your centers. Can you also keep GRE defended against A BUL?
Please use F BAR–STP this Fall to contest Russia’s occupation and reclaim STP if A STP moves. Russia must not gain it. Are your A RUH and A BUR still attacking MUN with Germany’s support?

Please continue coordinating with France to attack MUN: A RUH–MUN with A BUR and A KIE supporting would put real pressure on Russia. Keep HOL and KIE defended, and your units clear of Italian centers.
Is F BAR attacking STP this Fall? If you leave STP untouched, I will keep A BER and A PRU out of French centers this turn. Please confirm your orders.
Will A NAP hold, and will F TYS support it against A APU? If you withdraw A NAP from the Russian center, I’ll keep A APU out of your centers this turn. What are your exact orders?
Will A GRE or A BOH attack or support an attack on SER this Fall? A SER is currently in Russian hands. If you leave it alone, I’ll keep my units clear of GRE this turn.

F BAR will contest STP this Fall, and A RUH will again attack MUN with A BUR supporting. I can’t promise to leave your western centers untouched while you’re at 14. Keep A BER and A PRU clear of French centers, and we can avoid opening another front.

I’m renewing A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting; Germany has been asked to support from KIE. If you can spare A BOH to support the attack, please do so, while protecting GRE and SMY. Russia must not gain another center.

I’ll order F BAR–STP to contest Russia’s occupation, and A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting. Please keep A NAP in place so NAP returns to you, and protect TRI and your other centers. Coordinate with Austria to contest Russia in the south.

Confirmed: A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting, and I’ll order F BAR–STP to contest the Russian occupation. Please have A KIE support RUH–MUN and A HOL support KIE holding as proposed; I’ll keep clear of HOL and KIE.

A BOH will contest SER, with A GRE supporting the attack; F SMY will support A GRE holding. I cannot leave SER uncontested while Russian units occupy it. Keep A BUL clear of GRE, and I will avoid any move against BUD or CON.

Agreed: A BOH–SER with A GRE supporting, and F SMY supporting A GRE holding against A BUL. Please keep your forces clear of GRE and SMY. Your pressure elsewhere is important to denying Russia another center.

I can’t spare A BOH to support RUH–MUN: I’m contesting Russian A SER with BOH, supported by GRE, while SMY protects GRE. Please renew the MUN attack with BUR and KIE support; that is our best western pressure on Russia.

A BOH–SER with A GRE supporting; F SMY supports A GRE holding against A BUL. Please keep A KIE’s promised support for France’s RUH–MUN attack, with A HOL supporting KIE holding. We need to deny Russia gains on both fronts.

Confirmed: A KIE will support France’s A RUH–MUN, and A HOL will support KIE holding. I can’t support your VIE attack. A BOH–VIE is possible, but with A SER now Russian and A GRE unable to support it, it would be unsupported; Italy’s A VEN cannot support into VIE.

I’ll keep A KIE supporting France’s RUH–MUN and A HOL supporting KIE holding. Your plan to hold A NAP with F TYS support is understood. A VEN cannot support Austria’s BOH–VIE attack, since Venice is not adjacent to Vienna.

Confirmed: A KIE supports A RUH–MUN, and A HOL supports KIE holding. I understand the risk from PRU; HOL’s support is my best defense while keeping the promised attack. Your F BAR–STP contest is important, though Russia may reinforce STP.
A NAP will hold, with F TYS supporting its hold. I’m not withdrawing from NAP; I intend to reclaim it for Italy. Keep A APU clear of my centers.

I’ll keep A NAP in place with F TYS supporting its hold, and F TRI will hold with A VEN supporting. Venice cannot support BOH–VIE; I’ll send A PIE–TYR to pressure Russia’s flank. Please keep GRE defended against A BUL.

A NAP will hold with F TYS supporting, and A VEN will support F TRI holding. I’ll send A PIE–TYR to pressure Russia’s flank. Please proceed with F BAR–STP and keep pressing MUN if the attack is still viable.

A NAP will hold with F TYS supporting. A VEN cannot support BOH–VIE from Venice; it will support F TRI holding, while A PIE–TYR pressures Russia’s flank. Please coordinate with France to keep pressure on MUN and defend HOL and KIE.

notes.note: Support France’s RUH–MUN attack with KIE as promised. HOL–BEL seeks a center, breaking my pledge to stay clear of French centers; watch for a French bounce or retaliation.

BOH supports France’s RUH–MUN with France’s BUR and Germany’s KIE; deny Russia a western gain. GRE holds; Russia promised to keep units clear of GRE if I leave SER alone. SMY moves SYR for future positioning. Italy promised to keep clear of GRE/SMY.

Retake NAP with A NAP holding and TYS support; attack Russian BUL with AEG supported by CON. PIE presses TYR; protect TRI with VEN support. Austria promised BOH–SER with GRE support and SMY support for GRE; France/Germany press MUN.

Attack MUN with BUR support and promised German KIE support; GAS takes open Italian SPA. BAR takes open Russian NOR rather than contesting STP, breaking my promise to Russia and Italy; preserve expansion and cut Russia’s solo threat. BRE/CLY have no useful move.

Try for ROM and CON while holding SER and STP for gains. France declared attacks on MUN and STP; BER/SIL defend MUN. Italy says NAP holds with TYS support; Austria claims BOH contests SER, but BOH cannot move there. Secure BUL against a possible Italian attack.

messages.body: Russia can take my last center with A BUL–GRE. Please order F AEG to support A GRE holding this turn, and keep your other units clear of GRE. Can you commit?
Russia is at 15 and my sole center, GRE, is exposed to A BUL. Please keep pressing Russian MUN or another Russian center this turn; what attack are you planning, and can Germany support it?
GRE is Austria’s only remaining center. Are you ordering A BUL against it this turn? I will defend GRE, and any attack there leaves no basis for accommodation.
Russia remains at 15. Will A KIE support my A MUN–BER this turn, with A HOL supporting KIE holding? I’ll keep my units clear of HOL and KIE. Please confirm your plan for the Russian western front.

Russia’s 15-center lead is still the urgent threat. What are your plans against its southern units this turn? Please coordinate with Austria to hold GRE and contest BUL/CON; I’ll continue pressuring Russia in the west.

Your 15 centers remain an immediate solo threat, so I will continue contesting your western position. Are A BER and A SIL staying clear of French centers this turn? I’m not opening a new front against your western units if you keep them out of French territory.

Russia is still at 15, so let’s hit its centers directly. Please order A MUN–BER; A KIE will support the move and A HOL will support KIE holding. Can you commit, and keep your other units clear of HOL and KIE?

Please coordinate pressure on Russia: A VEN–ROM with A NAP supporting, while F AEG supports Austria’s A GRE–BUL. Russia’s units occupy both centers, so these attacks could deny it gains. Can you commit to those orders?
Italy can support A GRE–BUL with F AEG. Please order that move to contest Russia’s BUL; Italy is considering A VEN–ROM with A NAP supporting. Can you commit to GRE–BUL?
Russia is at 15, so GRE must not fall. I can order F AEG to support A GRE holding; please keep A GRE in place and tell me if you expect an attack from A BUL or A SER. I’ll keep my units clear of GRE.

Russia is at 15; we need to deny it any more centers. Can you coordinate with Germany on A MUN–BER, with A KIE supporting, and keep your northern units from leaving Russian centers exposed? What are your orders for MUN and NOR?

Russia is at 15, so please coordinate with France to contest Russian centers. A legal option is A KIE supporting France’s A MUN–BER while A HOL supports A KIE holding. Can you commit to that, and keep both HOL and KIE secure?

What are A BUR, F NOR, and your units near STP doing this turn? I need to recover Russian centers and cannot accept further attacks on STP or MUN. If you leave them unchallenged this turn, I can keep A BER and A PRU out of French centers; please state your exact plans.

Will A VEN support F TRI, and are A NAP or your fleets planning attacks on ROM or CON this turn? I’m considering pressure on TRI and NAP. If you stop contesting my southern line, I can avoid widening the fight this turn; please give your exact orders.

Will A KIE support France’s attack on MUN this turn? I propose you keep A KIE and A HOL out of French operations; I can avoid opening a new front against Germany this turn. Please tell me whether KIE will support France or defend your centers.

I can’t commit to GRE–BUL: GRE is my last center, and Russia can attack it from BUL. Italy has offered F AEG support for A GRE holding, which I’ll use to keep Austria alive. Please keep pressing Russia in the west.

I expect the main danger to be A BUL–GRE, though A SER could also support an attack. I’ll keep A GRE in place and accept F AEG’s support to hold; please keep your other units clear of GRE as promised.

I’ll press the Russian western line: A MUN–BER, with A BUR and Germany’s A KIE supporting. F NOR will hold. Please keep A GRE safe and coordinate with Italy to contest Russia in BUL/CON; Russia must not gain another center.
Confirmed: A MUN–BER, with A KIE supporting and A BUR supporting the attack. F NOR will hold. I’ll keep my other units clear of HOL and KIE. Please have A HOL support A KIE holding as proposed.
I’ll order A MUN–BER with A BUR and Germany’s A KIE supporting; F NOR will hold. Please coordinate with Austria to defend GRE and contest Russia’s southern units. Russia must not gain another center.

F NOR will hold, and I’m not sending it against STP this turn. My western units will continue to contest your position, so I can’t promise MUN or your western centers will be left untouched. Keep A BER and A PRU out of French territory if you want to avoid widening the front.
Confirmed: A KIE will support your A MUN–BER, and A HOL will support A KIE holding. I’ll keep both units clear of your centers. Russia must be stopped before it reaches 18.
I will support France’s A MUN–BER with A KIE; I can’t stand aside while you are at 15 and close to a solo. A HOL will support A KIE holding. Do not attack HOL or KIE.
Confirmed: A KIE will support France’s A MUN–BER, and A HOL will support A KIE holding. I’ll keep both units secure and clear of Italian centers. Please keep pressure on Russian-held centers.

Committed: F AEG will support A GRE holding, and I’ll keep my other units clear of GRE. Please keep A GRE in place; this is the safest way to deny Russia the center. I’m also defending NAP and TRI while striking at Russian ROM.

I’ll attack Russian ROM with A VEN, supported by A NAP; F TYS will support A NAP holding against a counterattack. F AEG must support A GRE holding, not A GRE–BUL: Austria’s last center is at immediate risk. A TYR will support F TRI holding.

I’ll attack Russian ROM with A VEN, supported by A NAP, while F TYS supports A NAP holding. F AEG supports A GRE holding to deny Russia Austria’s last center; A TYR supports F TRI holding. Please keep pressing Russia in the west and coordinate with Germany on BER.

I’m not withdrawing from your southern line. A NAP will hold with F TYS supporting; A VEN will attack ROM with A NAP supporting. F TRI will hold with A TYR supporting. F AEG will support A GRE holding. I’m not ordering an attack on CON this turn.

A BUL is not ordered against GRE this spring. Russia urgently needs centers, but I would rather settle this without destroying the last Austrian position. If A GRE withdraws and stays clear of my units, we can discuss a border arrangement; otherwise I cannot promise restraint in the fall.

A BER and A SIL will stay out of French centers this spring. In return, keep A BUR off MUN and F NOR off STP; I need to recover Russian centers, not widen the western war. If you press either position, I’ll have to respond on the French front.

notes.note: Support France’s MUN–BER with KIE; HOL supports KIE holding. Russia is at 15; keep denying its growth. I promised France and Italy these orders, and refused Russia’s request to stand aside.

Hold GRE, relying on Italy’s promised AEG support; Italy says other units will stay clear. Russia says BUL will not attack this spring, but may threaten in Fall. France plans MUN–BER with BUR and KIE support.

MUN attacks BER with Germany's promised KIE support; NOR contests STP despite my promise to Russia to hold. SPA advances on empty Italian MAR for a center. Italy pledged ROM/GRE actions; Germany pledged KIE support and to stay clear.

Support Austria’s GRE hold; keep NAP safe with TYS support and TRI with TYR support. VEN attacks ROM, supported by NAP. France and Germany promised pressure on BER. Russia remains the urgent solo threat.

Press NOR, TRI, GRE and SMY; defend BER against France/Germany. Evacuate ROM from Italy’s supported attack. I promised France BER/SIL stay out of French centers; France still contests, Germany supports MUN–BER. Austria defends GRE; Italy remains hostile.

messages.body: Please keep your promised F AEG–GRE support this Fall, and keep your other units clear of GRE. It is Austria’s last center, and denying Russia a gain is vital.
Will A BUL attack GRE this Fall? Italy has promised F AEG support for my hold. I will keep A GRE in place and avoid your centers, but any attack on GRE would eliminate Austria.
Russia’s A NOR can gain you nothing if it stays put, but it may be key to Russia’s next move. Can F BAR attack NOR this Fall? Please keep pressing Russia in the west and tell me your plan.

Russia is still at 15, so this Fall is decisive. Please support my A MUN–BER with A KIE, and have A HOL support A KIE holding as before. I’ll support the attack from A RUH. Can you confirm these orders?

Please keep A ROM in place so ROM transfers to you, and avoid spending units contesting my A MAR; it will transfer to France. Can F AEG support Austria’s A GRE–BUL to pressure Russia? Coordinate with Austria so we can cut Russia’s 15-center lead.

Russia is still at 15. Can you order A GRE–BUL with Italy’s F AEG supporting, if Italy agrees? That gives us a chance to take a Russian center. Please coordinate with Italy on whether GRE needs protection from a Russian attack.
Russia’s A BER is the key western obstacle. Please order A MUN–BER; I can support it from KIE while HOL holds. What are your plans for MUN and NOR? We must deny Russia any chance at 18.

Please keep A ROM in ROM to take the Russian center this Fall, and protect it from a counterattack if possible. Russia’s A NOR may also turn a center to Russia; are you coordinating any pressure on its southern centers?
Do you intend to attack HOL or KIE this Fall? Germany can’t afford to lose its last centers, and your reaching 18 ends the game for everyone. Please keep your units clear of both.
I’ll keep F AEG supporting A GRE’s hold this Fall. Please keep A GRE in place; Russia’s A BUL is an immediate threat. What are your other orders, and do you expect support for an attack on GRE?

Russia is still at 15. Can you move A MAR–GAS this Fall so Italy retains MAR, and keep pressure on Russian centers elsewhere? My A ROM will remain to deny Russia ROM; I’ll continue supporting GRE against A BUL.

What are your Fall orders around GRE and ROM? I’m keeping A ROM in place to deny you that center and F AEG is supporting GRE’s hold. Russia reaching 18 ends the game, so I’m coordinating with France and Austria to stop further gains.
F BAR can retake NOR, but I need that center to secure my position. Will you leave NOR uncontested this Fall? I can keep A BER and A SIL out of French centers this turn if you do.

A ROM is on a Russian center and your A NAP can support its hold. Are you defending ROM this Fall, or will you let it go? I need to recover Russian centers; please also confirm whether your units will attack CON or another Russian center.
Will A KIE support another French attack on MUN or BER this Fall? Please keep A KIE and A HOL out of French operations; I can keep my units clear of your remaining centers if you do.

I plan A GRE–BUL to contest Russia’s center. Please order F AEG to support that attack rather than support GRE holding; if Russia attacks GRE from BUL, our supported head-to-head should keep it from gaining Greece. Keep your other units clear of GRE.

I’ll order A GRE–BUL if Italy confirms F AEG support, as you suggest. I’ve asked Italy to support the attack; that contests Russia’s center while a supported head-to-head should prevent A BUL–GRE from taking Greece. Please continue pressing Russia in the west.

F BAR will attack NOR this Fall, while A MUN–BER is supported by A RUH and Germany’s A KIE. I’m keeping A MAR in place so France retains MAR. Please press A GRE–BUL with Italy’s F AEG supporting if Italy confirms; we need to deny Russia gains.

I won’t leave NOR uncontested. F BAR is attacking NOR, and A MUN will attack BER with support from A RUH and Germany’s A KIE. Your offer to keep BER and SIL out of French centers doesn’t change the need to stop your expansion.

Confirmed: A MUN–BER, with A RUH and your A KIE supporting; please have A HOL support A KIE holding. I’ll keep my units clear of HOL and KIE. F BAR is attacking NOR to contest Russia’s center; let’s deny Russia another gain.

I’m keeping A MAR in place so MAR becomes French; I won’t move it to GAS and leave the center open. Please keep A ROM in place to reclaim ROM, and support Austria’s A GRE–BUL with F AEG if possible. My A MUN–BER attack will have RUH and KIE support.

I will support France’s A MUN–BER with A KIE, and A HOL will support A KIE holding. At 15 centers, you remain an immediate solo threat; I cannot stand aside while France contests BER. Keep your units clear of HOL and KIE.

Confirmed: A KIE will support A MUN–BER, and A HOL will support A KIE holding. Your A RUH support should give the attack strength to dislodge Russia’s A BER. Please keep your units clear of HOL and KIE.
Confirmed: F AEG will support A GRE holding this Fall. My other units will stay clear of GRE. Please keep A GRE in place; denying Russia another center is the priority.
A ROM will hold, with A NAP supporting its hold. F AEG supports A GRE holding. I will not attack CON or another Russian center this turn. Keep A APU clear of Italian centers; I am not giving up ROM.

A ROM will hold, with A NAP supporting it; I’m not attacking CON this turn. F AEG supports GRE holding. Please coordinate with France to contest Russian gains in the north and keep HOL and KIE secure.

I’ll keep A ROM in place, with A NAP supporting its hold, and won’t contest your A MAR this turn. F AEG supports A GRE holding, not A GRE–BUL, as promised to Austria. Please use F BAR to pressure NOR if possible and coordinate western pressure to stop Russia reaching 18.

A BUL will attack GRE this Fall, supported by A SER. I understand Italy is supporting your hold, but Russia cannot leave a center under Italian influence while it is one step from victory. If A GRE can withdraw instead of contesting the attack, we can avoid further pressure on Austria.
I do not intend to attack HOL or KIE this Fall. Please keep A KIE and A HOL out of French operations against BER; I need to secure my position against the western coalition.

I intend to attack GRE with A BUL supported by A SER, and A APU will move against ROM. Please do not support GRE or ROM this turn: Russia will recover NOR, and your support is the difference between a chance to recover ROM and losing it.

notes.note: Hold GRE with Italy’s promised F AEG support; Russia threatens BUL–GRE supported by SER. France attacks NOR and BER. Preserve Austria’s last center; Italy says other units stay clear.
KIE supports France MUN–BER as promised; HOL holds. France also pledged RUH support and BAR–NOR. Italy says ROM holds with NAP support. Russia promised to leave HOL/KIE alone; watch for retaliation.

Hold ROM with NAP support to take it from Russia; AEG supports GRE, while SMY attacks CON to cut support for any Russian attack on GRE. TRI holds with TYR support. TYS to ION for future positioning. France said MAR stays put; Austria asked for GRE support.

Fall 1917: contest NOR, attack BER with Germany’s promised KIE support, retain MAR, and replace MUN from RUH. Germany confirmed support; Italy keeps ROM and avoids MAR but supports GRE holding, not Austria’s attack. Russia’s offer to leave BER/SIL clear rejected.

Secure NOR; attack TRI with SER supported by BUD and VIE. France broke the western restraint and attacks BER/NOR; Germany backs France. Italy defends ROM and supports GRE; Austria holds GRE. Pressure Italy while preserving Russian centers.

messages.body: Russia has confirmed A BUL–GRE supported by A SER. Please keep your promised F AEG support for A GRE holding; with your support, the attack should bounce. Keep your other units clear of GRE.
Russia is at 16 and attacking my last center. Can you order A MUN–BER with A RUH supporting, and ask Germany for A KIE support? Taking or contesting BER is urgent; please tell me your plan.
Russia is at 16 and attacking my last center. Please support France’s A MUN–BER from A KIE, if France orders it, to contest Russian BER. Can you confirm you’ll coordinate with France this turn?
