Russia’s A BER is still the key western threat. Please have A KIE support my A MUN–BER, with A HOL supporting A KIE holding. I’ll support from A BUR and A RUH. This gives us our best chance to take BER and deny Russia a western opening.

Please order F SMY–CON with F AEG supporting it. Austria can attack A BUL from GRE to pressure Russia’s southern line; the attack on CON may cut any support Russia sends from CON. Keep your centers protected while we try to take a Russian center.

Please coordinate with Italy’s F SMY–CON, supported by F AEG. Consider A GRE–BUL to pressure Russia and make it harder for A BUL to support CON. Keep GRE safe if the position makes the attack too risky; Russia must not gain centers.

Russia is now at 16, so we must contest it. Please order A MUN–BER with A RUH supporting; A KIE will support the attack and A HOL will hold. Can you commit, and what will you do about Russia’s A PRU and A SIL?

Russia is at 16. Please keep F AEG supporting A GRE holding so Russia cannot take Austria’s last center, and tell me whether you can also pressure a Russian center this turn. France and I are coordinating against BER.

Russia has 16 centers and GRE is in immediate danger. Please hold A GRE this turn; I’ve asked Italy to support it with F AEG. Can you confirm your plan and coordinate with Italy so Russia cannot take GRE?

Russia is at 16, so Greece must hold. Please keep A GRE in place; I will support its hold with F AEG. I’m also keeping A ROM with A NAP supporting its hold to deny Russia a gain there. What are your orders for GRE and SER?

Russia must not reach 18. Please attack A BER with A MUN, supported by A RUH, and coordinate A KIE support with Germany. I’ll defend ROM and support GRE. Can you commit to the BER attack and tell me your other moves against Russia?

Please support France’s A MUN–BER with A KIE, and keep A HOL supporting A KIE’s hold if needed. Russia is at 16, so taking BER back would help deny its solo. Can you commit and coordinate with France?

Is A GRE holding this spring, and will it receive Italian support? Russia needs centers and I will press GRE again; if A GRE vacates rather than contesting, I can avoid widening the fight against your remaining position this turn.

Will F AEG support A GRE this spring? I intend to press GRE from BUL with support from CON. If you withhold support there, I will keep my units clear of Italian centers this turn; please confirm your orders.
Will A KIE support France’s attack on BER this spring? Keep A KIE out of that operation and I will not attack HOL or KIE this turn. I need to know whether you intend to help France contest BER again.

A GRE will hold, and your F AEG support for its hold is essential. I have no unit in SER; please keep your other units clear of GRE. Russia threatens with A BUL supported by A SER, so I will not leave Greece exposed by attacking BUL.

Confirmed: A GRE will hold, with Italy’s F AEG supporting its hold. Russia threatens GRE from BUL with SER support, so I cannot spare the unit for another move. Please continue coordinating with France against BER.

A GRE is holding and will receive Italy’s F AEG support. I will not vacate Greece under your threat. An attack by A BUL supported from SER will meet this defense; withdrawing or promising to avoid widening the fight does not protect my last center.

I will keep A GRE holding with Italy’s F AEG support. With Russia’s A BUL–GRE supported by A SER, attacking BUL would expose Greece and risk my last center. Please continue MUN–BER with RUH and KIE support if Germany confirms.

Yes: A MUN–BER, supported by A BUR and A RUH; Germany has been asked to add A KIE support and keep A HOL holding. Please keep A GRE in place as your last center, ideally with Italy’s support. Italy can pressure CON from SMY.

I’ll attack BER with A MUN, supported by A BUR and A RUH, and send F BAR–NOR to contest Russia there. Please order F SMY–CON with F AEG supporting; Austria should keep A GRE holding. Russia is at 16, so we must deny it another center.

Confirmed: A MUN–BER with A BUR and A RUH supporting; please have A KIE support and A HOL support KIE holding. I’ll send F BAR–NOR to contest Russia. Your HOL support should help protect KIE if A PRU attacks; the BER assault is our best answer to A PRU and A SIL.
Confirmed: A KIE will support France’s A MUN–BER, and A HOL will support A KIE holding. I’m coordinating with France again. Please hold A GRE, and make sure F AEG supports it as Italy offered.

Confirmed: A KIE supports France’s A MUN–BER, and A HOL supports A KIE holding. I can’t spare a unit to pressure another Russian center. Please have F AEG support A GRE holding; Austria’s last center is at immediate risk.
I will support France’s A MUN–BER with A KIE; at 16 centers, I can’t stand aside while you remain close to a solo. A HOL will support A KIE holding. Do not attack HOL or KIE.

Confirmed: A KIE supports your A MUN–BER, and A HOL supports A KIE holding. Your support from A BUR and A RUH gives us our best chance to dislodge Russia’s A BER. I’ll keep both German units clear of your centers.

I’ll support F SMY–CON with F AEG, cutting A CON’s support for BUL–GRE rather than directly supporting A GRE’s hold. Keep A GRE in place; if Russia’s stated orders stand, this should leave its attack without the CON support it needs.

I can pressure a Russian center: F SMY–CON with F AEG supporting. I’ll keep A ROM defended with A NAP’s support. France’s and your pressure on BER is important; I can’t assist there with my current units.
I won’t leave Italian centers exposed, and I will act to prevent a Russian gain in Greece. I can’t agree to stop contesting your southern line; please keep A APU clear of Italian centers.

Agreed: F SMY–CON with F AEG supporting. That should cut A CON’s support for BUL–GRE if Russia follows through, while putting pressure on a Russian center. I’ll keep A ROM defended with A NAP supporting its hold.

notes.note: Hold GRE; it is Austria’s last center. Italy now says AEG supports SMY–CON, not GRE, despite earlier promises. Russia threatens BUL–GRE, but no Russian unit is listed in SER; France/Germany coordinate against BER.

Keep HOL supporting KIE’s hold and KIE supporting France’s MUN–BER attack as promised. Russia remains at 16; continue contesting its growth. France has confirmed BUR and RUH support; Russia asked me to stand aside, and I refused.

AEG supports SMY–CON to cut Russia's support against GRE; Austria holds GRE. NAP supports ROM, which holds against APU. France/Germany committed to BER; France also pressures NOR. Russia said it would keep clear of Italian centers if I acted against its south.

MUN–BER with Germany's promised KIE support; RUH replaces MUN, supported by BUR. BAR contests NOR. Italy promised SMY–CON with AEG support and to support GRE; Austria holds GRE. Advance toward BEL/Italy; watch Russia's 16-center threat.

France and Germany continue coordinating against BER; defend it with PRU and SIL while BOH probes MUN. France broke the NOR restraint last year; Germany openly supports French attacks. Austria holds GRE with Italian backing, and Italy refuses to yield. Press VEN, SMY, TYR, and GRE.

messages.body: Russia’s A BUL threatens my only center, GRE. Please order F AEG to support A GRE holding this Fall, rather than spending it on SMY–CON. I’ll keep A GRE in place. If F CON can safely stay put, that also secures CON for you at the turn’s end.
Please renew A MUN–BER with A BUR and A RUH supporting, and ask Germany to add A KIE support. Russia is at 16; taking or contesting BER is urgent. Tell me if your plan has changed.
Please order A KIE to support France’s A MUN–BER this Fall, with A HOL supporting A KIE holding as before. Russia is at 16, so contesting BER is urgent. Please confirm.

Russia can reach 18 this Fall through VEN and GRE. Please order A TYR–VEN with F ADR supporting, F AEG supporting A GRE to hold, and F CON holding so CON transfers back to you. Can you confirm these orders?
Russia is at 16 and this Fall may decide the game. Please renew A MUN–BER with A KIE supporting; I’ll support from A BUR and A RUH. Keep A HOL holding KIE. Please confirm.

Russia may reach 18 this Fall by taking GRE and VEN. Please keep A GRE holding; Italy has been asked to support it with F AEG. Can you confirm your order, and does Russia’s A BUL threaten GRE from your view?

Russia is at 16 and this Fall may reach 17 at VEN. Please make another serious attempt on BER: A MUN–BER with A BUR or A RUH supporting; I’ll have A KIE support the attack and A HOL support A KIE holding. Can you also contest a Russian center elsewhere?

Russia’s A VEN could give it another center this Fall. Can you order A TYR–VEN with F ADR supporting, and keep F CON in CON to secure that center? I’ll continue helping France contest BER and protect KIE.

You’re at 16 and another gain could put the game close to your solo. I’ll support France’s attack on BER again and keep A HOL supporting A KIE. Do you intend to attack HOL or KIE this Fall? Please leave my last centers alone.
Russia is at 16, so GRE must hold. Please keep A GRE in place this Fall; I can support its hold from F AEG. What are you ordering, and do you expect Russia to attack from BUL or SER?

Please confirm your Fall plans for BER and NOR, and coordinate with Germany if possible. Russia is at 16; taking a Russian center is essential. I’ll support Austria’s GRE hold and keep F CON defended.

What are your Fall orders around GRE and CON? I intend to support A GRE holding and keep F CON in place. Russia reaching 18 ends the game, so do not expect me to leave your southern centers uncontested.

What are F AEG, F ADR, and A TYR doing against GRE, CON, and VEN this Fall? I need to secure my southern centers. Keep your units off VEN and do not support GRE; I will keep A APU out of Italian centers this turn.

Will A MUN and A RUH attack or support an attack on BER this Fall, and where is F BAR moving? If you leave BER unchallenged, I will keep A BER and A PRU out of French centers. Please confirm your exact orders.

Will A KIE support France against BER again this Fall? Keep A KIE out of that operation and I will leave HOL and KIE unchallenged this turn. Please confirm whether you will support France or defend Germany.

A GRE will hold, and I accept F AEG’s support for its hold. A BUL is the immediate threat; there is no Russian A SER on the board to support it. Please keep F AEG on GRE rather than diverting it to CON.

Confirmed: A GRE will hold, with Italy’s F AEG supporting its hold. A BUL can attack, but there is no Russian A SER on the board to support it. Please continue pressing BER; keeping GRE safe is my priority.
No change: A MUN–BER, supported by A BUR and A RUH; Germany has confirmed A KIE support. Please keep A GRE holding, with Italy’s F AEG supporting, to deny Russia a gain.

I’ll renew A MUN–BER with A BUR and A RUH supporting; Germany confirms A KIE support. F BAR will attack NOR. Please keep F AEG supporting A GRE’s hold, F CON in place, and proceed with A TYR–VEN supported by F ADR.
Confirmed: A MUN–BER, with A BUR and A RUH supporting; please have A KIE support the attack and A HOL support A KIE holding. F BAR attacks NOR. I’ll keep my units clear of HOL and KIE.
A MUN will attack BER, supported by A BUR and A RUH, and F BAR will move to NOR. I won’t leave BER or NOR unchallenged; your offer to keep A BER and A PRU out of French centers does not change that.
Confirmed: A KIE will support France’s A MUN–BER, and A HOL will support A KIE holding. Russia at 16 remains an immediate solo threat; I can’t stand aside.
I will support France’s A MUN–BER with A KIE; A HOL will support A KIE holding. At 16 centers, I cannot risk your reaching 18. Please leave HOL and KIE unchallenged.
Confirmed: A KIE supports A MUN–BER, and A HOL supports A KIE holding. Your A BUR and A RUH support should give the BER attack its best chance. Russia must be stopped.

I’ll order F AEG to support A GRE holding, and A TYR and F ADR will stay clear of GRE. Please keep A GRE in place; denying Russia Greece is essential. F CON will remain in CON so it transfers to Italy.
Agreed: A TYR–VEN, with F ADR supporting the attack, while F CON holds. F AEG will support A GRE holding to deny Russia Greece. Please continue coordinating with France against BER.

F AEG will support A GRE holding, and F CON will remain in CON. I cannot promise to leave VEN uncontested while your A VEN occupies an Italian center. Keep A APU clear of my centers; I’m focused on stopping further gains.
Confirmed: A TYR–VEN with F ADR supporting, F AEG supporting A GRE holding, and F CON holding. Please continue your pressure on Russian centers; we must prevent Russia from gaining both VEN and GRE.

I will keep A VEN in VEN to secure the center, and A APU will contest NAP. F CON remains on a Russian center, so I cannot promise to keep clear of Italian centers while you hold it. If you withhold support for GRE and withdraw F CON, we can avoid widening the southern fight.

You have confirmed A KIE will support France against BER again, so I cannot promise to leave KIE unchallenged. A BER and A PRU must be ready to act against KIE; A SIL will help defend BER. Keep A HOL out of support for KIE and reconsider helping France take BER.

notes.note: Hold GRE; Italy promises F AEG support for the hold. Preserve Austria’s last center and deny Russia a solo. France/Germany are contesting BER.

HOL supports KIE holding; KIE supports France MUN–BER as promised. Russia threatens KIE from BER/PRU, so watch whether HOL’s support is enough. Italy says TYR–VEN with ADR support and CON holding; AEG supports GRE.

Contest VEN with TYR supported by ADR and ROM; keep CON to take it, and support Austria's GRE hold. NAP holds. France/Germany pledged pressure on BER/NOR; Russia threatened NAP and asked me to leave VEN alone.

MUN–BER with German KIE support; BUR enters MUN, RUH supports it. PIE supports Italy’s TYR–VEN; BAR switches from promised NOR to STP to contest a Russian center. Italy confirmed VEN/CON and GRE defense; Germany confirmed BER support.

France and Germany continue to attack BER; defend with BAL, PRU, SIL. Hold NOR against France and VEN to secure the pending gain, supported by APU. Press CON and TYR; Italy remains hostile, Austria holds GRE.

messages.body: Please confirm F AEG will support A GRE holding this turn. Russia has 15 centers, and Greece is the only barrier to an immediate solo; I will keep A GRE in place. What are your plans for F SMY and the Russian positions in the south?

Russia remains one center from victory. Please tell me your Spring plan to prevent a Russian gain, especially whether your western units can contest BER or another Russian center. I will hold A GRE; Italy’s F AEG support is essential.

A GRE will hold this turn, with Italy’s F AEG support. You are at 15 and any attack on Greece risks ending Austria without securing you a gain. What centers are you targeting this spring? I will not vacate GRE under threat.
Russia is back at 15, so we need another coordinated attack on BER. I’ll order A MUN–BER, with A BUR and A RUH supporting. Please have A KIE support the attack and A HOL hold KIE. Can you confirm?
Please help deny Russia a solo: order A VEN–TRI with F ADR supporting, and have F CON support Austria’s A GRE–BUL. Austria can keep GRE safe if the attack fails. Are you willing to do both?

Russia is at 15. Please order A GRE–BUL, with Italy’s F CON supporting if Italy agrees; this pressures a Russian center while I attack BER with German support. Can you coordinate with Italy and confirm your move?

Russia remains at 15 and its A BER/A PRU threaten KIE. Please renew A MUN–BER with A BUR or A RUH supporting; I can support from KIE and have HOL support KIE’s defense. What are your Spring orders, and can you contest a Russian center elsewhere?

Your A BER and A PRU threaten my last centers. I will not leave KIE exposed while Russia is at 15; are you ordering an attack on KIE or HOL this Spring? If you leave Germany alone, I can focus on denying your growth in coordination with France.
Russia remains at 15, and Austria’s A GRE is vulnerable to A BUL. Please have F AEG support GRE holding again this Spring. Are you also able to contest a Russian center with your units?

Russia remains at 15, and A BUL can threaten GRE. Please keep A GRE holding; I’ll consider F AEG support for its hold. What are your orders? We must deny Russia Greece and prevent any gain against Italian centers.

Please coordinate your Spring orders to contest Russian centers, especially BER or NOR, and tell me your target. I’ll defend my southern line and may attack Russian units near VEN; please keep your units clear of Italian centers.

Your A APU, A TUS, and A TYR threaten my centers. I will defend Italy and contest your southern line, while coordinating to deny you GRE. What are your Spring orders? Keep your units clear of NAP, ROM, and VEN.

Will F AEG withhold support for A GRE this spring, and will F CON stay out of the Russian line? If you leave GRE uncontested, I’ll keep A APU out of Italian centers this turn. Please confirm your exact orders.

Are A MUN, A BUR, and A RUH again attacking BER, and where is F BAR moving? I need to protect my centers. If you leave BER and NOR alone this spring, I can keep my western units out of French centers; please confirm.

Will A KIE support France against BER again this spring? If you keep A KIE out of that operation, I’ll leave HOL and KIE unchallenged this turn. Please confirm whether you’ll defend Germany or continue backing France.

Please commit F CON and F AEG to support A GRE–BUL. That gives the attack strength to beat any Russian A BUL–GRE supported from RUM, while taking a Russian center if BUL does not attack. I will order GRE–BUL; please confirm both supports.

I will order A GRE–BUL, asking Italy for F CON and F AEG support. That pressures a Russian center and should stop A BUL–GRE in the head-to-head. Please continue the BER attack with German support; Russia must not reach 18.

Please keep A GRE holding; leaving it for BUL risks Russia taking your last center. Italy can support GRE’s defense with F AEG while A VEN–TRI pressures Russia. I’m renewing A MUN–BER with A BUR and A RUH supporting, and Germany’s A KIE support.

Yes—A VEN–TRI with F ADR supporting is a useful way to take a Russian center. Please have F AEG support Austria’s A GRE hold; Russia’s A BUL could otherwise take GRE if Austria moves. Keep F CON safe or use it to support GRE’s defense, rather than supporting an attack on BUL.
Confirmed: A MUN–BER, with A BUR and A RUH supporting. Please have A KIE support the attack and A HOL hold KIE. I’ll also send F BAR to contest a Russian center. We need to stop Russia’s solo threat.

A MUN will attack BER, with A BUR and A RUH supporting; Germany has been asked to add A KIE support. F BAR will contest a Russian center. I won’t leave your western position unchallenged while you remain a solo threat.

I can’t support from KIE: A BER and A PRU can threaten it, so KIE will hold with HOL supporting. Please proceed MUN–BER with BUR and RUH supporting; that gives the attack strength 3. Russia may move BER out, but the attack still pressures its western position.

I will not stand aside while you remain at 15. I can’t send KIE to support BER this turn because A BER and A PRU threaten it; KIE will hold with HOL supporting. France is still attacking BER from MUN with BUR and RUH support. Leave HOL and KIE alone.
Yes: F AEG will support A GRE holding, and I’ll keep my other units clear of GRE. Russia’s units near VEN and my southern centers also require a careful defense; please keep A GRE in place.

I’m contesting Russia’s southern line while protecting Italian centers, and F AEG will support Austria’s GRE hold. I can’t commit to an attack on a Russian center this turn; please continue coordinating with France against BER or NOR.

I won’t send A VEN to TRI or have F CON support an attack on BUL: Russia’s units threaten my centers, and Austria needs GRE defended. F AEG will support GRE holding; I’m keeping my other units focused on defense.

I will not withhold support for GRE, and F CON will not stand aside from the southern line. Your APU, TUS, and TYR threaten Italian centers, so I’m defending them. Keep your units out of NAP, ROM, and VEN.

I’m not ordering A BUL against GRE this spring; Italy’s F AEG support makes that a poor attack. I’m focusing elsewhere for now, not making a lasting pledge. Please keep A GRE from supporting attacks against my southern units, and ask Italy to stop using F AEG to shield your center.

A APU, A TUS, and A TYR are positioned to contest your line, and I won’t promise to leave NAP, ROM, or VEN alone. Your F AEG support makes GRE difficult to take this turn; withhold it and keep F CON out of my line, and I can avoid widening the southern fight this spring.

If A KIE again supports France’s MUN–BER attack, I’m prepared to send A BER against KIE with support from A PRU and A SIL; HOL’s support for KIE will not be enough. Keep KIE out of French operations and I’ll leave HOL and KIE unchallenged this spring. Please confirm your orders.

notes.note: Hold GRE as Austria’s last center; Italy most recently promised F AEG support for the hold. Russia says it will not attack BUL this spring, but that is no lasting pledge. France urges holding while contesting BER.
Keep KIE defended and honor Russia’s offer to leave HOL/KIE alone if KIE stays out of France’s BER attack. France is attempting MUN–BER with BUR/RUH support; reassess if Russia breaks its promise.

Support VEN–TRI with ADR to contest Russia’s vacant center; AEG supports Austria’s GRE hold as promised. Keep CON, NAP, and ROM in place against nearby Russian units. France also urged the TRI move; Austria asked for GRE defense.

Press BER with MUN supported by BUR and RUH; take open POR with SPA and contest Russian STP with BAR. Move BRE toward GAS, PIC to BEL, EDI to YOR; PIE contests VEN. Germany declined KIE support; Italy refused VEN/TRI attack but will support GRE hold; Austria plans GRE–BUL.

Spring 1919: preserve BER against France’s supported attack; seek MUN with TYR, supported by BER/SIL. Attack CON with BUL+BLA support and ROM with TUS+APU support. Italy and Austria remain hostile; Germany backs France, despite saying KIE will hold.

messages.body: Russia can reach 18 if it keeps CON, MUN, and ROM. Please order A BUR–MUN with A RUH and A BEL supporting, and coordinate A KIE support with Germany. I’ll keep A GRE holding.
Russia can reach 18 by keeping CON, MUN, and ROM. Please support France’s A BUR–MUN attack with A KIE; France is being asked to add A RUH and A BEL support. Every contest matters this Fall.

Please order F SMY–CON with F AEG supporting the attack; A GRE will hold, so it cannot support you. Russia is poised to take CON, MUN, and ROM and reach 18. Can your other units contest ROM or otherwise deny Russia a center?
Russia’s A MUN could give it the third center for a solo. Please order A KIE to support my A BUR–MUN; I’ll have A RUH support the attack. Keep A HOL holding KIE if possible. Can you confirm?

Russia can reach 18 by keeping A CON, A MUN, and A ROM on those centers. Please attack CON with F SMY, supported by F AEG; Austria may be able to support that attack from GRE. I’m attacking MUN with A BUR, supported by A RUH. Can you commit to CON?

Russia’s A CON may complete its solo. Please keep A GRE in place and support Italy’s F SMY–CON if Italy orders it; GRE can support a move into CON. I’m attacking MUN with A BUR supported by A RUH, and have asked Germany for KIE support.

Russia’s A MUN can turn MUN this Fall. Please make retaking or dislodging it your priority: A BUR–MUN with A RUH supporting if possible. Your forces in STP and VEN also deny Russia centers if they stay put. I’ll keep HOL and KIE defended.

Please pressure Russia’s centers this Fall: F SMY–CON with F AEG supporting, and A NAP–ROM with F ADR supporting if you can spare them. Keep A TRI in TRI to take that center from Russia. We need to prevent a Russian solo.
Are you planning to attack HOL or KIE this Fall? I’ll defend both; please leave them alone while France and Italy contest your southern and western centers. Russia must not reach 18.

Russia’s A MUN, A CON, and A ROM could gain three centers this Fall. Please order A RUH–MUN supported by A BUR, and keep F STP/NORTH in STP to deny Russia that center. I’ll attack A CON from SMY with AEG support; that also cuts any support from CON against GRE.

Please support France’s A RUH–MUN from A KIE this Fall; France can support the attack from A BUR. Russia must not keep MUN, CON, and ROM for three gains. Keep A HOL clear of the attack and protect KIE as needed.

Please keep A GRE holding this Fall. I’m ordering F SMY–CON with F AEG supporting; the attack should cut any support Russia sends from CON against GRE. Russia’s A SER is the danger, so do not move A GRE away.

Are A BUR and A RUH attacking BER or MUN, and what is F STP/NORTH doing? If you leave BER and MUN unchallenged and move the fleet out of STP, I can keep A BER, A PRU, and A SIL out of BEL and RUH this turn.

Will A KIE support France against BER this Fall? Keep it out of that attack and I will leave HOL and KIE unchallenged this turn. France’s attacks threaten both our positions; please confirm your orders.
Will A NAP attack ROM or F ADR support it, and will F ADR contest CON? If you leave A ROM and A CON undisturbed this turn, I can keep A APU clear of NAP and avoid widening the southern fight.

I’ll keep A GRE in Greece and support Italy’s F SMY–CON. That strengthens the attack and may cut any Russian support from CON against Greece. Please renew your supported A BUR–MUN attack; denying Russia its gains is urgent.

I’ll order A GRE to support F SMY–CON; the unit remains in Greece, and the support may also cut any Russian support from CON against it. Please keep F AEG supporting the attack as planned, and make sure GRE stays clear of your other units.

Please keep A GRE holding; Russia’s A BUL could otherwise take your last center. Italy is attacking CON from SMY with AEG support, while I’ll attack MUN from BUR with RUH support and keep F STP/North in STP. These moves should deny Russia its solo.
I’ll attack A MUN with A BUR, supported by A RUH. KIE cannot support an attack on MUN, so please keep A HOL and A KIE safe; don’t risk KIE against PRU. Russia must be denied its centers this Fall.

I won’t leave MUN unchallenged or move F STP/North out of STP. A BUR will attack MUN with A RUH supporting; I’m also keeping A VEN in place. Your offer to keep BER, PRU, and SIL clear of French centers doesn’t change that.

Please follow through with F SMY–CON, supported by F AEG; taking CON is crucial to denying Russia its solo. I’ll attack MUN from BUR with RUH support and keep F STP/North in STP, while A VEN remains in VEN. Keep your other units clear of French centers.

I can’t spare A KIE to support France’s MUN attack: A BER and A PRU threaten KIE. I’ll hold KIE with A HOL supporting it. France can still attack MUN with A BUR and A RUH supporting; please keep A GRE defended.

I can’t support your MUN attack from KIE without leaving KIE exposed to Russia’s A BER/A PRU. I’ll hold KIE with A HOL supporting. Please attack A BUR–MUN with A RUH supporting; Russia must not be allowed to keep MUN uncontested.
A KIE will stay out of France’s attack and hold, with A HOL supporting KIE. Please leave HOL and KIE unchallenged this turn; I’m preserving Germany’s last two centers.
I can’t support the MUN attack from KIE while A BER and A PRU threaten my last centers. I’ll hold KIE with A HOL supporting. Please press CON and ROM as you proposed, and keep A TRI in TRI.

I’m contesting both Russian-held Italian centers: F SMY–CON supported by F AEG, and A NAP–ROM supported by F ADR. A TRI will hold to reclaim TRI for Italy. Please keep A GRE in place; I can’t spare F AEG to support GRE this Fall.

I’ll attack A ROM with A NAP, supported by F ADR, and attack CON from F SMY with F AEG supporting. A TRI will hold to reclaim TRI for Italy. Please keep coordinating with France against MUN, and ensure STP stays French so Russia cannot regain it.

Confirmed: F SMY–CON with F AEG supporting, and A NAP–ROM with F ADR supporting. A TRI will hold to reclaim it for Italy. Please follow through on A BUR–MUN supported by A RUH, and keep F STP/NORTH in STP to deny Russia.

I won’t leave CON or ROM undisturbed: F SMY attacks CON with F AEG supporting, and A NAP attacks ROM with F ADR supporting. A TRI will hold. Keep A APU clear of NAP; I’m defending Italian centers and will not stand aside while your units occupy them.

I have no order planned against HOL or KIE this Fall; I’m focused on the southern and western fights. Please keep A KIE and A HOL out of French attacks on BER and MUN, and let us avoid widening the front.

notes.note: Hold GRE to preserve Austria’s last center and guard against Russia’s A SER. Italy diverted F AEG to support SMY–CON despite earlier support-for-GRE promises; France and Italy are contesting Russian centers.
Attack ROM from NAP with ADR support and CON from SMY with AEG support; hold TRI to reclaim it. France promised BUR–MUN and STP hold; Germany could not support MUN. Austria promised GRE hold.

Attack MUN with BUR, RUH supporting; hold POR, STP, VEN to claim/deny centers. Italy promised SMY–CON with AEG support and NAP–ROM with ADR support; Austria promised to support CON from GRE and hold GRE. Germany declined MUN support.
Secure CON, ROM, and MUN while NOR with LVN support retakes STP; together these should reach 18. Italy attacks CON and ROM; France attacks MUN and holds STP. Counter with support.
Keep HOL and KIE defended; HOL supports KIE holding, KIE holds. Honor Russia’s promise to leave them alone and stay out of France’s MUN attack. France and Italy are contesting Russian centers.

messages.body: Russia is at 17, so A BUL–GRE could end the game. Please order F AEG to support A GRE holding this Spring; I will hold GRE. Confirm that AEG will not be diverted to another attack.

Russia needs only one center for a solo. Please renew the attack on MUN with A BUR–MUN supported by A RUH, and coordinate any available pressure on BER. I will hold GRE; Italy’s F AEG support is vital against A BUL.
You are one center from victory, and A GRE is your only immediate route to 18. Are you ordering A BUL against GRE this Spring? I will hold; please name the center you intend to target instead.
Russia still needs only one center to win. Please keep A GRE holding this turn; do not move it away from Greece. Can Italy commit F AEG to support its hold again?
Please help contest Russia’s A MUN: I’ll order A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting. Can A KIE support the attack while A HOL supports A KIE holding? Russia must not get a center from our side.

Please support Austria’s A GRE hold with F AEG, and consider A NAP supporting my A VEN–ROM to pressure Russia’s A ROM. I’ll make the move if you confirm; keeping Russia from gaining a center is urgent.
Russia is at 17; we must deny it a Fall gain. Please target A MUN with A BUR–MUN supported by A RUH, and avoid German centers. I’ll keep A HOL supporting A KIE’s hold. What are your Spring orders?

Russia needs only one center to win. Can you contest CON with F AEG supported by F SMY and ROM with A NAP supported by F ADR? Please tell me your Spring orders; Germany will keep HOL and KIE defended.

Germany will defend HOL and KIE, and I’m coordinating with France and Italy to prevent a Russian solo. Are you planning to attack either German center this Spring? If you leave them alone, tell me which fronts you intend to press.

Russia is at 17, so we must deny any gain this turn. I’ll order F SMY–CON with F AEG supporting. Please attack a Russian-held center with your northern units and keep A VEN clear of Italian centers. Which target are you committing to?

Russia is at 17 and can win by taking one center. Please keep A GRE in place this Spring; don’t move it to BUL unless we can guarantee Greece remains defended. I’ll contest CON from SMY with AEG support. What are you ordering?
You’re at 17, so any center gained ends the game. I will contest CON from SMY with AEG support; please keep A APU clear of NAP and don’t attack GRE. What are your orders around Italy and Austria?

Will F AEG support A GRE holding or will F SMY again attack CON this Spring? If you keep F AEG out of Greece and F SMY out of CON, I can keep A APU clear of NAP this turn. Please confirm your exact orders.

Is A GRE holding this Spring, and will Italy’s F AEG support it? Russia needs a center to win; if you vacate GRE or leave it unsupported, I can avoid widening the attack against your remaining position.

Are A BUR and A RUH again attacking MUN, and where are F BAR and your eastern units moving? I need to protect my centers. If you leave MUN and BER alone this Spring, I can keep A BER and A PRU out of French centers this turn.

A GRE will hold this Spring; I have asked Italy to support its defense. I will not vacate under threat. Are you positioning against Greece, or targeting another center? If you attack GRE, France and Italy will keep contesting your centers.

Please order F AEG to support A GRE holding, not F SMY–CON. If Russia takes GRE in the Fall, it wins immediately; this defense is our priority. I will hold Greece. Can F SMY still attack CON without AEG support?

Please keep pressing Russian centers, especially with A BUR–MUN supported by A RUH, and coordinate any available pressure on BER. Russia needs one center for a solo, so I’m holding GRE and have asked Italy to support its defense. Please tell me what you can contest this Spring.

A RUH–MUN, supported by A BUR, is my commitment; F BAR will move to NOR, and A VEN will pressure ROM. I will not leave MUN or BER alone. Your offer to keep BER and PRU out of French centers does not change that.
Please keep A GRE holding, with Italy’s F AEG supporting its hold. I’m attacking MUN with A RUH–MUN supported by A BUR, and will also pressure ROM from VEN. We need to deny Russia any Fall gain.
I’m committing A VEN–ROM to pressure Russia’s A ROM. Can A NAP support that attack? Please also follow through with F SMY–CON supported by F AEG, and coordinate with Austria to keep GRE defended.

I’ll attack MUN with A RUH–MUN supported by A BUR. Please keep A KIE and A HOL safe and avoid supporting Russian moves; I understand KIE is exposed if it supports my attack. F BAR will contest NOR, and A VEN will pressure ROM.

I can’t support RUH–MUN from KIE while keeping KIE defended: if KIE moves, HOL cannot support its hold, and BER/PRU/SIL threaten it. I’ll keep A KIE holding with A HOL supporting. Please proceed with RUH–MUN and BUR support; I’ll keep both German centers secure.
F AEG will support A GRE holding, and F SMY will stay out of your centers. Keep A APU clear of NAP and do not attack GRE; any move against Italian or Austrian centers risks widening the fight.
Confirmed: F AEG will support A GRE holding this Spring. Please keep A GRE in place; Russia must not take your center. I’m also acting against the Russian position in Italy.
F AEG will support A GRE holding. A NAP will support France’s A VEN–ROM, while F ADR attacks APU to cut any support for the Russian unit in ROM. F SMY will hold.
Yes. F AEG supports A GRE holding, and A NAP supports your A VEN–ROM. I’ll order F ADR–APU to cut any Russian support from APU into ROM; F SMY holds. Please make the ROM attack.
I’m focusing my southern forces on the Italian front this Spring, not widening pressure on your last center. Keep A GRE in place and avoid supporting attacks against my units.
I’ll keep A APU clear of NAP this turn, but I won’t leave CON exposed to your attack. I’m also addressing the Austrian front; I won’t promise to leave GRE alone.
I have no Spring order against HOL or KIE. I’m pressing the southern front instead; please keep A HOL and A KIE out of French operations against my western units.

notes.note: Hold GRE, Austria’s last center. Italy most recently confirmed F AEG will support the hold; Russia says it is focusing on Italy, but may still threaten. France and Italy are contesting Russian centers.

HOL holds; KIE supports France’s RUH–MUN attack to help deny Russia a solo. France and Italy are contesting Russian centers. Russia promised to leave HOL/KIE alone and says it is pressing south; watch for a breach.

AEG supports Austria’s GRE hold; NAP supports France’s VEN–ROM; ADR attacks APU; SMY holds. France committed to VEN–ROM and northern pressure. Austria promised to hold GRE. Russia is at 17; deny any center.

Contest NOR and MUN; attack ROM with Italy’s NAP support. Italy promised ADR–APU and AEG support for Austria’s GRE hold; Austria holds GRE. Germany holds KIE with HOL support. Russia is at 17—deny any Fall gain.

Italy promises SMY stays out of CON; AEG supports GRE. Austria holds GRE. France commits BUR-RUH against MUN, VEN toward ROM, BAR-NOR. Try TRI from SER; defend ROM and MUN, contest NOR. Hold TRI in Fall for 18.

messages.body: Russia wins if A TRI stays. Please order F ADR–TRI, with A GRE supporting the attack; can F AEG or another unit add support? I will support F ADR–TRI from GRE. This is the decisive defense—do not use F ADR elsewhere.

Russia wins if A TRI remains there. Please use A PIE to support Italy’s F ADR–TRI attack if legal from PIE, and make every available attack on Russian centers this Fall. I’ll support ADR–TRI from GRE; can you confirm your order?

A TRI is exposed to an attack from Italy’s F ADR, supported by A GRE. France is also being asked to contest your centers. If you have a different target for your final gain, name it now; I will not help you take Greece.

Russia is at 17. Please support my A ROM holding with A NAP and keep F AEG supporting A GRE; Russia can attack ROM from TUS with A APU support and TRI can attack GRE. Keeping both centers defended is essential.
Russia can still reach 18 this Fall. Please keep A GRE holding; Italy says F AEG can support its defense. Russia’s A TRI can attack GRE, so do not leave it exposed.
Russia at 17 may attack KIE from MUN, with BER able to support. Please keep A KIE holding and A HOL supporting its defense; don’t move either unit away from the KIE defense.

Your A TRI currently occupies Italy’s center, so holding it this Fall gives you an immediate solo win. Please move A TRI out of TRI; France’s A ROM can take ROM back, denying you any gain. I will keep HOL and KIE out of your way if you leave German centers alone.

Urgent: Russia is at 17 and A TRI occupies TRI, so Russia wins if it stays there. Can you attack TRI with F ADR to pressure it, and have A NAP support France’s A ROM holding? Ask Russia directly to vacate TRI; that is the only clear way to prevent its solo.

Russia is at 17; its A TRI occupying TRI means an immediate solo if it stays. Please keep A ROM in ROM to reclaim that center, and coordinate with Italy for A NAP to support ROM holding against A APU. Can you press Russia to vacate TRI this Fall?
I will order F AEG to support A GRE holding. Please keep A GRE in place; Russia must not take GRE this Fall. Let me know if you see any other immediate Russian threat to an Austrian center.
Please keep A ROM in ROM this Fall. I’ll order A NAP to support A ROM holding, to help deny Russia a recapture from TUS or APU. My A TRI will hold to return TRI to Italy.
Russia is at 17, so please defend KIE and HOL against attacks from MUN or PRU. Can A HOL support A KIE holding while you keep both centers? I’m coordinating defense of GRE and ROM in the south.

I need to keep ROM Russian while TRI changes hands this Fall. Will you leave A ROM unsupported and avoid supporting its defense? I can keep my western units from pressing your centers this turn if you do.
I need ROM and TRI to secure the position this Fall. Please keep F ADR from supporting A ROM’s defense, and keep A NAP out of ROM. I’ll keep A APU clear of NAP if you do.

I’ll keep A GRE in place and rely on F AEG’s support for its hold. I need to correct my earlier suggestion: GRE is not adjacent to TRI, so A GRE cannot support F ADR–TRI. Please attack from ADR if you can, but don’t count on support from me.

I’ll keep A GRE in place; F AEG supporting its hold should protect it from A BUL. I need to correct my earlier request: neither A GRE nor A PIE can support F ADR–TRI, as neither is adjacent to TRI. Please use your units against Russian centers where they can legally act.

A PIE cannot support ADR–TRI: Piedmont is not adjacent to Trieste. Please support Italy’s attack from GRE as you proposed, and keep GRE defended. I’m arranging to defend ROM; do not count on French support from PIE.

No. I will not leave A ROM unsupported or help you retain it; Italy has agreed to support its defense. Your offer to keep western units clear does not change that. You still need to account for the attack on TRI.

I’ll keep A ROM defended, and your support from NAP is essential. Please follow through on ADR–TRI with Austria’s support from GRE; Russia reaching 18 must be prevented. I can’t support that attack from PIE, which is not adjacent to TRI.

I’ll keep A ROM defended with Italy’s promised NAP support; I won’t give Russia that center. Please keep HOL and KIE secure. Russia’s TRI must also be dislodged this Fall, so coordinate with Italy and Austria on the ADR–TRI attack.

Please order A NAP to support France’s A ROM holding and F ADR–TRI. France keeping ROM while Italy retakes TRI prevents Russia’s solo; the NAP support may also stop a Russian attack on ROM. I’ll keep A KIE holding with A HOL supporting.

Please keep A ROM holding. Italy can support it with A NAP while F ADR attacks TRI; holding ROM denies Russia the solo even if TRI falls to Russia. I’ll keep A KIE holding with A HOL supporting its defense.

I’ll order F ADR–TRI, with A GRE supporting the attack, and A NAP supporting A ROM to hold. F AEG cannot support an attack on TRI, and NAP cannot support it either; I’ll keep AEG in place. Please make sure GRE supports ADR–TRI as offered.

I can’t leave ROM undefended or let TRI remain yours. A NAP will support A ROM holding, and F ADR will attack TRI with Austrian support. I can’t promise to keep APU clear of NAP while your units threaten Italian centers.
I’ll order F ADR–TRI with A GRE supporting, and A NAP will support France’s A ROM holding. I can’t add support to the TRI attack from AEG or NAP, so Austria’s support is essential.
A NAP will support A ROM holding. Austria is supporting my F ADR–TRI attack from GRE; since GRE will be supporting that attack, I can’t also have F AEG support GRE holding. I’ll keep AEG in place.

TRI is my immediate priority, and I will defend it against Italy’s attack. Please do not support F ADR into TRI. I am not asking you to help me take GRE, but I cannot offer a lasting promise to leave it untouched.

I will not move A TRI out merely to let France retake ROM; that would leave Russia no better off. I’m not targeting HOL or KIE this Fall. Keep your units out of France’s operations against my centers, and I’ll keep the German front quiet this turn.

notes.note: Keep HOL supporting KIE's hold and KIE holding to protect Germany's last centers. Russia promised to leave HOL/KIE alone; France requested this defense. Italy promised ADR–TRI with GRE support and NAP support for ROM; France promised to hold ROM. Watch whether Russia stays in TRI.
Hold GRE, Austria’s last center and Russia’s immediate solo route. Italy promised F AEG supports the hold; France urged defense. Russia says TRI is its priority, so expect an attack.

Attack Russian TRI from ADR; AEG supports Austria’s GRE hold and NAP supports France’s ROM hold to deny Russia’s solo. Austria confirmed GRE hold but correctly noted GRE cannot support the TRI attack. SMY attacks CON without support.

Fall 1920: take NOR with BAR; keep ROM to reclaim it, relying on Italy's promised NAP support. BUR–MUN supported by RUH; PIE–TUS pressures Russia. Italy says Austria supports ADR–TRI, but GRE cannot support TRI; Italy cannot also support GRE. Germany promises KIE/HOL defense.

Prioritize retaining TRI for the solo; BUD supports it, while RUM backs BUL against Italy. Defend MUN, BER, and NOR; APU attacks NAP to cut support as TUS probes ROM. Italy/Austria hostile; France refuses to yield ROM.

messages.body: Please order F AEG to support A GRE holding this Spring; Greece is my only center and Russia’s 16 makes it critical. Can F ADR also contest A TRI, and what are your other orders against Russia?
Please coordinate a strong attack on MUN: A RUH–MUN supported by A BUR, and ask Germany for A KIE support. Russia’s 16 means we need to deny it any gains this turn. What are you ordering?
Can A KIE support France’s A RUH–MUN attack this Spring, with A HOL supporting KIE holding? Russia’s 16 makes a coordinated attack on MUN urgent. Please confirm your plan.
Russia has several routes to an 18th center. Please order A NAP to support my A ROM holding, F AEG to support A GRE holding, and F CON to hold. I’ll keep A ROM in place; Austria should hold GRE.
Please keep A GRE in GRE this Spring. Italy can support its hold with F AEG; Russia can attack from TRI and BUL, so we must not leave Greece exposed. I’m coordinating defense of ROM and KIE as well.

Russia may target KIE from BER/PRU. Please order A HOL to support A KIE holding and keep both units in place. I can order A RUH to support A KIE holding, giving it a stronger defense against Russian attacks.

Russia is still at 16. Please keep A ROM defended and coordinate pressure on A MUN—A RUH–MUN with A BUR supporting if feasible. I’ll keep A KIE and A HOL defending Germany; I cannot spare KIE for an attack.

Can you order F ADR–TRI again this Spring, with A GRE supporting the attack? Russia remains at 16, so contesting its centers matters. Please also keep ROM defended and tell me what support Austria has confirmed.
Russia remains at 16. Can A GRE support Italy’s F ADR–TRI attack this Spring? Please coordinate directly with Italy and confirm; I’ll keep A HOL and A KIE defending Germany.
Russia still needs only two centers to win. I plan F AEG to support A GRE holding; please keep A GRE in GRE and do not support an attack elsewhere. Can you confirm?

Russia is at 16 and A TUS/APU threaten ROM. Please keep A ROM in place; I’ll order A NAP to support its hold and F ADR to APU to cut any support from there. Please tell me your orders around ROM and the northern front.

Russia needs only two centers to win, and A MUN/PRU threaten your last centers. Please defend both HOL and KIE; can A HOL support A KIE holding? France and I are coordinating to deny Russian gains—what are your orders?

I’m focused on the southern front this Spring. Keep F ADR out of TRI and don’t support defense of NAP; I’ll keep A APU from attacking NAP this Spring. Are you willing to leave me a route to take two centers this year rather than continue contesting TRI?
Russia needs two centers to win. If A GRE vacates to ALB and you let me take GRE, I will not attack ALB this Spring. Will you leave Greece open, or are you committing to hold it again?

I’m focusing on Italy and Austria this Spring, not French centers. Please keep A ROM out of support for Italy’s defenses and leave my western centers unchallenged this turn. Can you confirm your orders around MUN and the south?
GRE is not adjacent to TRI, so A GRE cannot support F ADR–TRI. I’ll keep A GRE in Greece. Please use A KIE to support France’s attack on MUN if you can; Russia’s 16 centers make every contest urgent.

Confirmed: A GRE will hold in Greece. GRE cannot support F ADR–TRI, since it is not adjacent to TRI. Please order F AEG to support A GRE holding as planned, and contest Russian centers with your other units.

I’ll keep A GRE in Greece; please make sure Italy’s F AEG supports its hold. GRE cannot support an attack on TRI. Please press MUN and other Russian centers wherever your units can legally attack, and coordinate Germany’s KIE support.
I will not vacate Greece or leave it open for you. A GRE will hold, with Italy asked to support it. Your offer not to attack ALB does not change my decision; I will not help you take my last center.

I’ll order A RUH to support A KIE holding, alongside your A HOL support. A BUR will pressure MUN, but I can’t commit RUH to the MUN attack while KIE is exposed. Please keep both A KIE and A HOL in place.

I’ll keep A ROM holding; your A NAP support and F ADR–APU are essential. I’ll order A BUR–MUN and F BAR–NOR to pressure Russia in the north. A RUH will support Germany’s A KIE holding, so I can’t support a MUN attack from there.

Please keep A GRE holding, with Italy’s F AEG supporting its hold. I’ll order A BUR–MUN to pressure Russia, but A RUH must support Germany’s A KIE holding rather than the MUN attack. Italy is supporting A ROM and cutting A APU with F ADR.
No. I’ll keep A ROM holding with Italy’s A NAP support, and I won’t leave your western centers unchallenged: A BUR will pressure MUN and F BAR will contest NOR. Italy is also ordering F ADR–APU.

I’ll keep A HOL supporting A KIE’s hold, and A KIE will support France’s A RUH–MUN attack. I’ve asked Austria to support your F ADR–TRI with A GRE, but don’t yet have confirmation. Please keep A ROM defended and press TRI.
Confirmed: A KIE will support France’s A RUH–MUN, and A HOL will support A KIE holding. I also ask you to support Italy’s F ADR–TRI attack with A GRE; please confirm that order directly with Italy.

I’ll order A HOL to support A KIE holding and A KIE to support your A RUH–MUN attack. I recommend A BUR support the attack; A RUH cannot both move to MUN and support KIE. Please keep A ROM defended and coordinate with Italy on TRI.

I’m prioritizing defense over another unsupported attack on TRI: F ADR–APU to cut any support from there, A NAP supports A ROM holding, F AEG supports A GRE holding, and F CON holds. Austria has asked me to support GRE; I have no fresh confirmation of its exact order.

I’ll order F AEG to support A GRE holding, and F CON will hold. F ADR will go to APU to cut any Russian support against ROM rather than make an unsupported attack on TRI. A NAP will support France’s A ROM holding.

Confirmed: A NAP supports A ROM holding, F AEG supports A GRE holding, and F CON holds. F ADR goes to APU to cut any support from that unit. A ROM should stay put; I’m prioritizing denying Russia gains over an unsupported attack on TRI.

No. I won’t leave you a route to two centers: F ADR will attack APU, A NAP will support A ROM holding, and F AEG will support A GRE holding. F CON will hold. I’m not agreeing to stand aside while you threaten Italian and allied centers.

notes.note: Hold GRE, Austria’s last center; Italy promised F AEG support for the hold. Russia needs two centers to win, so do not trust its offer to leave ALB alone.

Russia is at 16; defend both German centers with mutual support. France's RUH also supports KIE holding. Italy asked for this defense. France’s earlier MUN-attack plan is superseded; preserve HOL and KIE.
Contest APU; support Austria’s GRE hold and France’s ROM hold, keep CON occupied. Russia remains at 16 and is the urgent solo threat. Austria confirmed GRE holds; France promised ROM holds.

Russia has 16; deny the solo while pressing NOR and MUN. Italy promised NAP support for ROM, ADR–APU, and AEG support for GRE; Austria holds GRE. Germany promised HOL support for KIE. I kept RUH supporting KIE.

Try for SMY with ARM and VEN with TUS supported by TRI to reach 18 this Fall. Italy promises ADR-APU, NAP supports ROM, AEG supports GRE; France pressures MUN/NOR and holds ROM. Austria holds GRE. Defend MUN/BER; keep watching for support cuts.

messages.body: Russia can win by keeping both SMY and VEN. Please order A PIE–VEN supported by A ROM. Italy can order F ADR–TRI to cut A TRI’s support for VEN; that should let your attack dislodge A VEN.

Please order F CON–SMY supported by F AEG: the attack should cut any F BLA support for A SMY and dislodge it. Also order F ADR–TRI to cut A TRI’s support for VEN, so France’s A PIE–VEN (supported by A ROM) can succeed. I’ll hold GRE.

Russia can reach 18 by holding both VEN and SMY this Fall. Please order A GRE–TRI to cut support from A TRI to VEN, even if the attack only bounces. Italy and I can then attack VEN while Italy retakes SMY.

Urgent: Russia wins if it keeps both VEN and SMY. Please order F CON–SMY supported by F AEG, and F ADR to support my A PIE–VEN. A GRE–TRI from Austria should cut support from A TRI. Please also have A NAP support my A ROM holding against A APU.
You can reach 18 by holding VEN and SMY this Fall. What are A TRI and A SMY doing? Austria can attack TRI from GRE, and Italy and I are coordinating pressure on both centers.

Urgent: coordinate to dislodge A VEN. Please order A ROM–APU to cut any Russian support for VEN, and A PIE to support Italy’s F ADR–VEN. Italy can then attack VEN with support while its F AEG–SMY is supported by F CON.

Urgent: please order F ADR–VEN, supported by France’s A PIE, to dislodge the Russian unit; ask France to order A ROM–APU to cut any APU support for VEN. Also order F AEG–SMY with F CON supporting. These two attacks can deny Russia its 18th center.
Your A SMY and A VEN give you a solo if they stay. Are you planning to move either unit out this Fall? Germany will keep HOL and KIE defended, but I urge you to avoid ending the game with a solo.

Russia's A VEN must be dislodged this Fall. Please order A PIE–VEN, keep A ROM holding, and let my F ADR support A PIE–VEN. I'll have A NAP support A ROM holding. A ROM cannot support the attack without exposing Rome.
Please hold A GRE this Fall. F AEG will support its hold, while F CON attacks Russian A SMY without support. France and I are coordinating an attack on A VEN; Russia must not gain either center.
I need VEN to remain Russian this Fall to end the game. Will you keep A ROM and A PIE out of attacks or support against VEN? I will hold A VEN and am not asking you to concede any other center.
I need SMY to remain Russian this Fall to end the game. Please keep F AEG out of attacks on SMY and avoid supporting any attack on it. I will hold A SMY; can you confirm your orders?

I will hold A GRE; F AEG’s support is essential if Russia attacks from BUL. Your A PIE–VEN with A ROM support is the right attack, and Italy’s F ADR–TRI can cut A TRI’s support. GRE cannot move to or support TRI.

I will hold A GRE, and please keep F AEG supporting its hold as you propose. F ADR–TRI is important to cut A TRI’s support for VEN. F CON–SMY unsupported may fail if Russia uses F BLA to support A SMY, but do not divert AEG from Greece.
No. A PIE is committed against VEN, and I will not leave Russian centers unchallenged. You should not count on A ROM or A PIE staying out of the fight.

Please order A GRE–TRI to cut A TRI’s support for VEN, even if the attack only bounces. I’m ordering A PIE–VEN, with Italy’s F ADR supporting; Italy is also attacking SMY. Keep GRE safe from any other attack if possible.
Confirmed: I’ll order A PIE–VEN. Please have F ADR support A PIE–VEN, F CON–SMY supported by F AEG, and A NAP support A ROM holding. Austria is ordering A GRE–TRI to cut A TRI’s support for VEN.

I’m not ordering A ROM–APU: it would expose ROM, and A APU is not the support for VEN we need to cut. I’m ordering A PIE–VEN with Italy’s F ADR support; Austria is attacking TRI. Please keep HOL supporting KIE and defend both German centers.

I can’t agree to leave SMY unchallenged while your units also occupy VEN. F CON will attack SMY with F AEG supporting, and F ADR will contest TRI. I’m coordinating to make sure neither center can safely remain under your control.

I’ll order F CON–SMY with F AEG supporting, and F ADR–TRI to cut A TRI’s support for VEN. Please order A PIE–VEN and have A ROM support that attack; A NAP can support A ROM holding. This gives both center attacks their best chance.

Please keep A GRE holding. I’ll use F AEG to support F CON–SMY and send F ADR–TRI to cut A TRI’s support for VEN; I can’t also have AEG support GRE’s hold. These attacks are necessary to deny Russia VEN and SMY.

I’ll order F CON–SMY with F AEG supporting, and F ADR–TRI to cut A TRI’s support for VEN. France is coordinating A PIE–VEN with A ROM supporting, while A NAP supports A ROM holding. Please keep HOL and KIE defended.

A TRI and A SMY are not being offered to anyone, and I intend to keep both centers. I know you and Italy are coordinating pressure, but I won’t withdraw from either under threat. Austria’s move against TRI will not change that.

I’m not ordering against HOL or KIE this turn. A VEN and A SMY are staying in place; I won’t vacate them merely to prevent a Russian victory. Keep Germany out of the southern fight and leave my units unchallenged.

notes.note: Hold GRE, Austria’s last center; Russia needs two centers to win. Italy diverted AEG to support CON–SMY, so do not rely on its promised support. France/Italy are contesting VEN and SMY.

Mutually support HOL and KIE; Russia promised to leave them alone, but its 16-center solo threat is imminent. France and Italy are attempting to stop VEN/SMY; their latest plans conflict, so reassess next turn.
Support France PIE–VEN with ADR; attack SMY with CON supported by AEG; NAP supports ROM hold. France promised PIE–VEN, Austria promised GRE–TRI and GRE hold. Deny Russia’s solo.

Russia has 16; critical to dislodge VEN and deny its solo. PIE–VEN supported by ROM and Italy’s promised ADR; BUR–MUN supported by RUH; BAR contests NOR. Italy also promised CON–SMY with AEG support; Austria’s final message says GRE holds, not TRI. Germany promised to defend HOL/KIE.

Secure solo: APU/TRI support VEN; BUD supports TRI. SMY holds while BLA supports BUL–CON to dislodge CON and stop its attack. Attack KIE with BAL supported by BER/MUN; reinforce BER, MUN. Occupy WAR/MOS/NOR.
